kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā ṅentaṃ svāhāntaṃ praṇavādikam ..
pādayugmaṃ ca sarvāṅgaṃ santataṃ pātu sarvataḥ .. 39 ..
2.56.d:
कृष्णप्राणाधिका ङेन्तं स्वाहान्तं प्रणवादिकम् ॥
पादयुग्मं च सर्वाङ्गं सन्ततं पातु सर्वतः ॥ 39 ॥
2.56.m:
“Kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāyai svāhā,” ending in the dative case, ending with svāhā, beginning with the praṇava [oṃ]—
may it continually protect both feet and all limbs on all sides. // 39

2.56.s:
prācyāṃ rakṣatu sā rādhā vahnau kṛṣṇapriyā'vatu ..
dakṣe rāseśvarī pātu gopīśā nairṛte'vatu .. 2.56.40 ..
2.56.d:
प्राच्यां रक्षतु सा राधा वह्नौ कृष्णप्रियाऽवतु ॥
दक्षे रासेश्वरी पातु गोपीशा नैरृतेऽवतु ॥ 2.56.40 ॥
2.56.m:
May that Rādhā protect [me] in the east; may the beloved of Kṛṣṇa protect in the southeast;
may the Queen of the Rāsa dance protect in the south; may the Lady of the cowherd maidens protect in the southwest;

2.56.s:
paścime nirguṇā pātu vāyavye kṛṣṇapūjitā ..
uttare santataṃ pātu mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī .. 41 ..
2.56.d:
पश्चिमे निर्गुणा पातु वायव्ये कृष्णपूजिता ॥
उत्तरे सन्ततं पातु मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी ॥ 41 ॥
2.56.m:
may she who is devoid of gunas protect in the west; may she who is worshipped by Kṛṣṇa protect in the northwest;
may the primordial Prakṛti, the sovereign Goddess, always protect in the north;

2.56.s:
sarveśvarī sadaiśānyāṃ pātu māṃ sarvapūjitā ..
jale sthale cāntarikṣe svapne jāgaraṇe tathā .. 42 ..
2.56.d:
सर्वेश्वरी सदैशान्यां पातु मां सर्वपूजिता ॥
जले स्थले चान्तरिक्षे स्वप्ने जागरणे तथा ॥ 42 ॥
2.56.m:
may the universal Sovereign, she who is worshipped by all, always protect me in the northeast;
in water, on land, and in the sky, in dream as well as in waking,

2.56.s:
mahāviṣṇośca jananī sarvataḥ pātu santatam ..
kavacaṃ kathitaṃ durge śrījaganmaṅgalaṃ param .. 43 ..
2.56.d:
महाविष्णोश्च जननी सर्वतः पातु सन्ततम् ॥
कवचं कथितं दुर्गे श्रीजगन्मङ्गलं परम् ॥ 43 ॥
2.56.m:
may the mother of Mahāviṣṇu constantly protect [me] on all sides.
Thus the armour named Śrījaganmaṅgala has been declared, O Durgā, supreme.

2.56.s:
yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ param ..
tava snehānmayā'' khyātaṃ pravaktavyaṃ na kasyacit..44..
2.56.d:
यस्मै कस्मै न दातव्यं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं परम् ॥
तव स्नेहान्मया'' ख्यातं प्रवक्तव्यं न कस्यचित्॥44॥
2.56.m: It must not be given to just anyone; it is the most secret of secrets, supreme.

2.56.s:
gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ..
kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau dhṛtvā viṣṇusamo bhavet ..45..
2.56.d:
गुरुमभ्यर्च्य विधिवद्वस्त्रालङ्कारचन्दनैः॥
कण्ठे वा दक्षिणे बाहौ धृत्वा विष्णुसमो भवेत् ॥45॥
2.56.m: wearing [it] on the neck or on the right arm, one becomes equal to Viṣṇu.

2.56.s:
śatalakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ ca kavacaṃ bhavet ..
yadi syātsiddhakavaco na dagdho vahninā bhavet .. 46 ..
2.56.d:
शतलक्षजपेनैव सिद्धं च कवचं भवेत् ॥
यदि स्यात्सिद्धकवचो न दग्धो वह्निना भवेत् ॥ 46 ॥
2.56.m:
By reciting [it] ten million times, the armour becomes perfected.
If one has mastered this armour, one will not be burned by fire.

2.56.s:
etasmātkavacāddurge rājā duryyodhanaḥ purā ..
viśārado jalastambhaṃ vahnistambhaṃ ca niścitam .. 47 ..
2.56.d:
एतस्मात्कवचाद्दुर्गे राजा दुर्य्योधनः पुरा ॥
विशारदो जलस्तम्भं वह्निस्तम्भं च निश्चितम् ॥ 47 ॥
2.56.m:
From this armour, O Durgā, King Duryodhana long ago
[became] skilled in arresting water and arresting fire, surely.

2.56.s:
mayā sanatkumārāya purā dattaṃ ca puṣkare..
sūryyaparvaṇi merau ca sa sāndīpanaye dadau..48..
2.56.d:
मया सनत्कुमाराय पुरा दत्तं च पुष्करे॥
सूर्य्यपर्वणि मेरौ च स सान्दीपनये ददौ॥48॥
2.56.m:
Long ago at Puṣkara it was given by me to Sanatkumāra;
and at a solar eclipse on Mount Meru, he gave it to Sāndīpani.

2.56.s:
ballāya tena dattaṃ ca dadau duryyodhanāya saḥ..
kavacasya prasādena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ..49..
2.56.d:
बल्लाय तेन दत्तं च ददौ दुर्य्योधनाय सः॥
कवचस्य प्रसादेन जीवन्मुक्तो भवेन्नरः॥49॥
2.56.m: By him it was given to Balla, and he gave it to Duryodhana.

2.56.s:
nityaṃ paṭhati bhaktyedaṃ tanmantropāsakaśca yaḥ..
viṣṇutulyo bhavennityaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet..2.56.50..
2.56.d:
नित्यं पठति भक्त्येदं तन्मन्त्रोपासकश्च यः॥
विष्णुतुल्यो भवेन्नित्यं राजसूयफलं लभेत्॥2.56.50॥
2.56.m:
He who daily recites this with devotion, and is a worshipper of her mantra,
becomes perpetually equal to Viṣṇu and obtains the fruit of a Rājasūya sacrifice.

2.56.s:
snānena sarvatīrthānāṃ sarvadānena yatphalam..
sarvavratopavāsena pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇaiḥ..51..
2.56.d:
स्नानेन सर्वतीर्थानां सर्वदानेन यत्फलम्॥
सर्वव्रतोपवासेन पृथिव्याश्च प्रदक्षिणैः॥51॥
2.56.m:
Whatever fruit is attained by bathing in all sacred fords, by giving all gifts,
by observing all vows and fasts, and by circumambulations of the earth,

2.56.s:
sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣāyāṃ nityaṃ vai satyarakṣaṇe ..
nityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasevāyāṃ kṛṣṇanaivedyabhakṣaṇe .. .. 52 ..
2.56.d:
सर्वयज्ञेषु दीक्षायां नित्यं वै सत्यरक्षणे ॥
नित्यं श्रीकृष्णसेवायां कृष्णनैवेद्यभक्षणे ॥ ॥ 52 ॥
2.56.m:
by initiation into all sacrifices, by always upholding truth,
by constant service to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, by eating Kṛṣṇa's food offerings,

2.56.s:
pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ yatphalaṃ ca labhennaraḥ ..
tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ paṭhanātkavacasya ca .. 53 ..
2.56.d:
पाठे चतुर्णां वेदानां यत्फलं च लभेन्नरः ॥
तत्फलं लभते नूनं पठनात्कवचस्य च ॥ 53 ॥
2.56.m:
and whatever fruit a man obtains from reciting the four Vedas,
that fruit he surely obtains from reciting the armour.

2.56.s:
rājadvāre śmaśāne ca siṃhavyāghrānvite vane ..
dāvāgnau saṃkaṭe caiva dasyucaurānvite bhaye .. 54 ..
2.56.d:
राजद्वारे श्मशाने च सिंहव्याघ्रान्विते वने ॥
दावाग्नौ संकटे चैव दस्युचौरान्विते भये ॥ 54 ॥
2.56.m:
At the king's gate and at the cremation ground, in a forest filled with lions and tigers,
in a forest fire and in distress, and in fear caused by bandits and thieves,

2.56.s:
kārāgāre vipadgraste ghore ca dṛḍhabandhane ..
vyādhiyukto bhavenmukto dhāraṇātkavacasya ca .. 55 ..
2.56.d:
कारागारे विपद्ग्रस्ते घोरे च दृढबन्धने ॥
व्याधियुक्तो भवेन्मुक्तो धारणात्कवचस्य च ॥ 55 ॥
2.56.m:
in prison, when overtaken by calamity, and in dreadful and tight bonds,
even one afflicted with disease becomes freed by wearing this armour.

2.56.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ durge tavaivedaṃ maheśvari..
tvameva sarvarūpā māṃ māyā pṛcchasi māyayā ..56..
2.56.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं दुर्गे तवैवेदं महेश्वरि॥
त्वमेव सर्वरूपा मां माया पृच्छसि मायया ॥56॥
2.56.m:
Thus this has been related, O Durgā; this belongs to you alone, O Great Goddess.
You yourself are all forms; you, Māyā, ask me through māyā."

2.56.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
ityuktvā rādhikākhyānaṃ smāraṃsmāraṃ ca mādhavam ..
pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro babhūva saḥ .. 97 ..
2.56.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
इत्युक्त्वा राधिकाख्यानं स्मारंस्मारं च माधवम् ॥
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वाङ्गः साश्रुनेत्रो बभूव सः ॥ 97 ॥
2.56.m:
Having spoken this narrative of Rādhikā, constantly remembering Mādhava,
with his entire body bristling with horripilation, his eyes became filled with tears.

2.56.s:
na kṛṣṇasadṛśo devo na gaṅgāsadṛśī sarit ..
na puṣkarātparaṃ tīrthaṃ na varṇo brāhmaṇātparaḥ .. 58 ..
2.56.d:
न कृष्णसदृशो देवो न गङ्गासदृशी सरित् ॥
न पुष्करात्परं तीर्थं न वर्णो ब्राह्मणात्परः ॥ 58 ॥
2.56.m:
There is no god equal to Kṛṣṇa; there is no river equal to the Gaṅgā;
there is no sacred ford superior to Puṣkara; there is no caste superior to the Brahmin.

2.56.s:
paramāṇoḥ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ paro mahān ..
nabhaḥ paraṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ yathā nāstyeva nārada .. 59 ..
2.56.d:
परमाणोः परं सूक्ष्मं महाविष्णोः परो महान् ॥
नभः परं च विस्तीर्णं यथा नास्त्येव नारद ॥ 59 ॥
2.56.m:
There is nothing subtler than an atom; there is none greater than Mahāviṣṇu;
just as there is nothing more extensive than space, O Nārada;

2.56.s:
yathā na vaiṣṇavājjñānī yogīndraḥ śaṅkarātparaḥ ..
kāmakrodhalobhamohā jitāstenaiva nārada .. 2.56.60 ..
2.56.d:
यथा न वैष्णवाज्ज्ञानी योगीन्द्रः शङ्करात्परः ॥
कामक्रोधलोभमोहा जितास्तेनैव नारद ॥ 2.56.60 ॥
2.56.m:
just as there is no knower superior to a Vaiṣṇava, nor a master of yoga superior to Śaṅkara;
desire, anger, greed, and delusion have been conquered by him alone, O Nārada.

2.56.s:
svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvatkṛṣṇadhyānarataḥ śivaḥ ..
yathā kṛṣṇastathā śambhurna bhedo mādhaveśayoḥ .. 61 ..
2.56.d:
स्वप्ने जागरणे शश्वत्कृष्णध्यानरतः शिवः ॥
यथा कृष्णस्तथा शम्भुर्न भेदो माधवेशयोः ॥ 61 ॥
2.56.m:
In dream and waking, Śiva is continually devoted to meditating on Kṛṣṇa.
As is Kṛṣṇa, so is Śambhu; there is no difference between Mādhava and the Lord.

2.56.s:
yathā śambhurvaiṣṇaveṣu yathā deveṣu mādhavaḥ ..
tathedaṃ kavacaṃ vatsa kavaceṣu praśastakam .. 62 ..
2.56.d:
यथा शम्भुर्वैष्णवेषु यथा देवेषु माधवः ॥
तथेदं कवचं वत्स कवचेषु प्रशस्तकम् ॥ 62 ॥
2.56.m:
As Śambhu is among the Vaiṣṇavas, and as Mādhava is among the gods,
so is this armour the most excellent among armours, my child.

2.56.s:
śiśabdo maṅgalārthaśca vakāro dātṛvācakaḥ ..
maṅgalānāṃ pradātā yaḥ sa śivaḥ parikīrttitaḥ .. 63 ..
2.56.d:
शिशब्दो मङ्गलार्थश्च वकारो दातृवाचकः ॥
मङ्गलानां प्रदाता यः स शिवः परिकीर्त्तितः ॥ 63 ॥
2.56.m:
The syllable 'śi' signifies auspiciousness, and the syllable 'va' expresses a giver;
he who is the giver of auspicious things is celebrated as Śiva.

2.56.s:
narāṇāṃ santataṃ viśve śaṃ kalyāṇaṃ karoti yaḥ ..
kalyāṇaṃ mokṣa ityuktaṃ sa evaṃ śaṅkaraḥ smṛtaḥ..64..
2.56.d:
नराणां सन्ततं विश्वे शं कल्याणं करोति यः ॥
कल्याणं मोक्ष इत्युक्तं स एवं शङ्करः स्मृतः॥64॥
2.56.m:
He who continually creates well-being ('śam') and welfare for men in the universe—
welfare is declared to be liberation—he is thus remembered as Śaṅkara.

2.56.s:
brahmādīnāṃ surāṇāṃ ca munīnāṃ vedavādinām..
teṣāṃ ca mahatāṃ devo mahādevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ..65..
2.56.d:
ब्रह्मादीनां सुराणां च मुनीनां वेदवादिनाम्॥
तेषां च महतां देवो महादेवः प्रकीर्तितः॥65॥
2.56.m:
Of Brahmā and the other gods, and of sages who proclaim the Veda,
he is the god of those great ones; [hence] he is celebrated as Mahādeva.

2.56.s:
mahatī pūjitā viśve mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī. ..
tasyā devaḥ pūjitaśca mahādevaḥ sa ca smṛtaḥ .. 66 ..
2.56.d:
महती पूजिता विश्वे मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी॥।
तस्या देवः पूजितश्च महादेवः स च स्मृतः ॥ 66 ॥
2.56.m:
The primordial Prakṛti, the great sovereign Goddess, is worshipped in the universe;
and her worshipped god is remembered as Mahādeva.

2.56.s:
viśvasthānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mahatāmīśvaraḥ svayam ..
maheśvaraṃ ca tenemaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ .. 67 ..
2.56.d:
विश्वस्थानां च सर्वेषां महतामीश्वरः स्वयम् ॥
महेश्वरं च तेनेमं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ॥ 67 ॥
2.56.m:
He is himself the Lord of all the great beings residing in the universe;
therefore the wise proclaim him as Maheśvara.

2.56.s:
he brahmaputra dhanyo'si yadguruśca maheśvaraḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇa bhaktidātā yo bhavānpṛcchati māṃ ca kim .. 68 ..
iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde rādhikopākhyāne tanmantrādikathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāya..56..
iti rādhopākhyānam ..
2.56.d:
हे ब्रह्मपुत्र धन्योऽसि यद्गुरुश्च महेश्वरः ॥
श्रीकृष्ण भक्तिदाता यो भवान्पृच्छति मां च किम् ॥ 68 ॥
इति श्रीब्रह्मवैवर्त्ते महापुराणे द्वितीये प्रकृतिखण्डे नारदनारायणसंवादे राधिकोपाख्याने तन्मन्त्रादिकथनं नाम षट्पञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्याय॥56॥
इति राधोपाख्यानम् ॥
2.56.m:
O son of Brahmā, fortunate are you whose guru is Maheśvara,
the giver of devotion to Śrī Kṛṣṇa! Why do you ask me?
Thus ends the fifty-sixth chapter, named 'The Discourse on Her Mantra and Other Matters' in the Rādhikā episode, in the Nārada-Nārāyaṇa dialogue, in the second [book], the Prakṛtikhaṇḍa, of the glorious Mahāpurāṇa Brahmavaivarta.
Thus ends the episode of Rādhā.

2.57.s:
nārada uvāca ..
sarvākhyānaṃ śrutaṃ brahmannatīva paramādbhutam..
adhunā śrotumicchāmi durgopākhyānamuttamam..1..
2.57.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
सर्वाख्यानं श्रुतं ब्रह्मन्नतीव परमाद्भुतम्॥
अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि दुर्गोपाख्यानमुत्तमम्॥1॥
2.57.m:
Nārada said: / All the narratives have been heard, O Brahman, extremely and supremely wondrous. / Now I wish to hear the excellent episode of Durgā. // 1
“Durgā”, “Nārāyaṇī”, “Īśānā”, “Viṣṇumāyā”, “Śivā”, “Satī”, / “Nityā”, “Satyā”, “Bhagavatī”, “Śarvāṇī”, “Sarvamaṅgalā”, // 2
“Ambikā”, “Vaiṣṇavī”, “Gaurī”, “Pārvatī”, and “Sanātanī”— / these are the names spoken by the Kauthumas, bestowing auspiciousness on everyone. // 3
Tell the meaning of these sixteen names, which grants the desired boon to all, / O best among knowers of the Veda, agreed upon by all and stated in the Veda! // 4
By whom was she worshipped first, or by whom second in the past, / or by whom third or fourth, and by whom everywhere? // 5
Nārāyaṇa said: / Viṣṇu himself explained in the Veda the meaning of the sixteen names. / Though knowing it, you ask again; I shall relate it according to tradition. // 6
"Durga" denotes a demon, a great obstacle, the bond of mundane existence, and action; / grief, sorrow, hell, the punishment of Yama, and birth; // 7
great fear, and extreme disease; and the sound "ā" denotes the destroyer. / That goddess who slays all these is celebrated as Durgā. // 8
Equal to Nārāyaṇa in fame, splendour, forms, and virtues, / she is the power of Nārāyaṇa; therefore she is remembered as Nārāyaṇī. // 9
"Īśāna" is in the sense of all spiritual attainments, and the sound "ā" expresses the giver; / she who gives all spiritual attainments is also celebrated as Īśānā. // 10
Māyā was emitted formerly at creation by Viṣṇu, the Paramātman; / the universe is deluded by that māyā, so she is proclaimed as Viṣṇumāyā. // 11
In Śiva she is the embodiment of auspiciousness, the bestower of welfare, and the beloved of Śiva. / The sound "ā" denotes the beloved and the giver; therefore she is proclaimed as Śivā. // 12
The presiding goddess of good intellect, present in age after age, / a devoted wife of good character, she is celebrated as Satī. // 13
Just as the Lord is eternal, so is Bhagavatī eternal; / by her own māyā she disappears there into the Lord at the dissolution of Prakṛti. // 14
From Brahmā down to a clump of grass, everything is indeed false and fabricated; / Durgā has the nature of truth, like Prakṛti, like the Lord. // 15

2.57.s:
durgā nārāyaṇīśānā viṣṇumāyā śivā satī ..
nityā satyā bhagavatī śarvāṇī sarvamaṅgalā..2..
2.57.d:
दुर्गा नारायणीशाना विष्णुमाया शिवा सती ॥
नित्या सत्या भगवती शर्वाणी सर्वमङ्गला॥2॥

2.57.s:
ambikā vaiṣṇavī gaurī pārvatī ca sanātanī..
nāmāni kauthumoktāni sarveṣāṃ śubhadāni ca..3..
2.57.d:
अम्बिका वैष्णवी गौरी पार्वती च सनातनी॥
नामानि कौथुमोक्तानि सर्वेषां शुभदानि च॥3॥

2.57.s:
arthaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ varam..
brūhi vedavidāṃ śreṣṭha vedoktaṃ sarvasammatam ..4..
2.57.d:
अर्थं षोडशनाम्नां च सर्वेषामीप्सितं वरम्॥
ब्रूहि वेदविदां श्रेष्ठ वेदोक्तं सर्वसम्मतम् ॥4॥

2.57.s:
kena vā pūjitā sā''dau dvitīye kena vā purā ..
tṛtīye vā caturthe vā kena sarvatra pūjitā .. 5 ..
2.57.d:
केन वा पूजिता सा'ऽदौ द्वितीये केन वा पुरा ॥
तृतीये वा चतुर्थे वा केन सर्वत्र पूजिता ॥ 5 ॥

2.57.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
arthaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca viṣṇurvede cakāra saḥ ..
jñātvā punaḥ pṛcchasi tvaṃ kathayāmi yathāgamam .. 6 ..
2.57.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
अर्थं षोडशनाम्नां च विष्णुर्वेदे चकार सः ॥
ज्ञात्वा पुनः पृच्छसि त्वं कथयामि यथागमम् ॥ 6 ॥

2.57.s:
durgo daitye mahāvighne bhavabandhe ca karmmaṇi ..
śoke duḥkhe ca narake yamadaṇḍe ca janmani .. 7 ..
2.57.d:
दुर्गो दैत्ये महाविघ्ने भवबन्धे च कर्म्मणि ॥
शोके दुःखे च नरके यमदण्डे च जन्मनि ॥ 7 ॥

2.57.s:
mahābhaye'tiroge cāpyāśabdo hantṛvācakaḥ ..
etānhantyeva yā devī sā durgā parikīrttitā ..8..
2.57.d:
महाभयेऽतिरोगे चाप्याशब्दो हन्तृवाचकः ॥
एतान्हन्त्येव या देवी सा दुर्गा परिकीर्त्तिता ॥8॥

2.57.s:
yaśasā tejasā rūpairnārāyaṇasamā guṇaiḥ ..
śaktirnārāyaṇasyeyaṃ tena nārāyaṇī smṛtā .. 9 ..
2.57.d:
यशसा तेजसा रूपैर्नारायणसमा गुणैः ॥
शक्तिर्नारायणस्येयं तेन नारायणी स्मृता ॥ 9 ॥

2.57.s:
īśānaḥ sarvasiddhyarthe cāśabdo dātṛvācakaḥ ..
sarvasiddhipradātrī yā sā'pīśānā prakīrttitā ..2.57.10..
2.57.d:
ईशानः सर्वसिद्ध्यर्थे चाशब्दो दातृवाचकः ॥
सर्वसिद्धिप्रदात्री या साऽपीशाना प्रकीर्त्तिता ॥2.57.10॥

2.57.s:
sṛṣṭā māyā purā sṛṣṭau viṣṇunā paramātmanā ..
mohitaṃ māyayā viśvaṃ viṣṇumāyā prakīrttitā ..11..
2.57.d:
सृष्टा माया पुरा सृष्टौ विष्णुना परमात्मना ॥
मोहितं मायया विश्वं विष्णुमाया प्रकीर्त्तिता ॥11॥

2.57.s:
śive kalyāṇarūpā ca śivadā ca śivapriyā ..
priye dātari cāśabdaḥ śivā tena prakīrtitā ..12..
2.57.d:
शिवे कल्याणरूपा च शिवदा च शिवप्रिया ॥
प्रिये दातरि चाशब्दः शिवा तेन प्रकीर्तिता ॥12॥

2.57.s:
sadbuddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī vidyamānā yuge yuge..
pativratā suśīlā ca sā satī parikīrtitā..13..
2.57.d:
सद्बुद्ध्यधिष्ठातृदेवी विद्यमाना युगे युगे॥
पतिव्रता सुशीला च सा सती परिकीर्तिता॥13॥

2.57.s:
yathā nityo hi bhagavānnityā bhagavatī tathā..
svamāyayā tirobhūtā tatreśe prākṛte laye..14..
2.57.d:
यथा नित्यो हि भगवान्नित्या भगवती तथा॥
स्वमायया तिरोभूता तत्रेशे प्राकृते लये॥14॥

2.57.s:
ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva kṛtrimam..
durgā satyasvarūpā sā prakṛtirbhagavānyathā..15..
2.57.d:
आब्रह्मस्तम्बपर्यन्तं सर्वं मिथ्यैव कृत्रिमम्॥
दुर्गा सत्यस्वरूपा सा प्रकृतिर्भगवान्यथा॥15॥

2.57.s:
siddhaiśvaryādikaṃ sarvaṃ yasyāmasti yuge yuge ..
siddhādike bhago jñeyastena sā bhagavatī smṛtā ..16..
2.57.d:
सिद्धैश्वर्यादिकं सर्वं यस्यामस्ति युगे युगे ॥
सिद्धादिके भगो ज्ञेयस्तेन सा भगवती स्मृता ॥16॥
2.57.m:
In whom all attainments, sovereign powers, and the like exist in age after age— / "bhaga" is to be known as attainments and the like; therefore she is remembered as Bhagavatī. // 16
She leads all to liberation, [beyond] birth, death, old age, and the like, / and all moving and unmoving things in the universe; therefore she is proclaimed as Śarvāṇī. // 17
"Maṅgala" is a word for liberation, and the sound "ā" expresses the giver; / she who gives all liberations is indeed Sarvamaṅgalā. // 18
"Maṅgala" is proclaimed in the sense of joy, prosperity, and welfare; / she gives these to all; therefore she is Sarvamaṅgalā. // 19
"Ambā" is a word for mother, always in praise and worship; / she is worshipped and praised as the mother of the worlds; therefore she is Ambikā. // 20
Devoted to Viṣṇu, having the form of Viṣṇu, possessing the nature of Viṣṇu's power, / and created by Viṣṇu at creation, she is therefore proclaimed as Vaiṣṇavī. // 21
"Gaura" is in the sense of yellow, unattached, and in the supreme, spotless Brahman; / this power belongs to that Self; therefore she is proclaimed as Gaurī. // 22
Śambhu is the guru of all, and his power is Satī; / Kṛṣṇa is the guru, and she is his māyā; therefore she is proclaimed as Gaurī. // 23
In variations of lunar days, divisions of festival days, divisions of kalpas, and other distinctions, / she is celebrated among them; therefore she is proclaimed as Pārvatī. // 24
She is well proclaimed as "parvan" in the sense of a particular great festival; / she who is its presiding deity is celebrated as Pārvatī. // 25
The goddess is the daughter of the mountain, and she manifested on the mountain; / she is the presiding deity of the mountain; therefore she is proclaimed as Pārvatī. // 26
"Sanā" is stated to mean at all times, and "tanī" in the sense of extended; / existing everywhere and at all times, she is Sanātanī. // 27
The meaning of the sixteen names has been proclaimed, O great sage; / listen now to the episode declared in the Veda according to tradition. // 28
First she was worshipped by Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman, / in Vṛndāvana at the beginning of creation, in Goloka in the circle of the rāsa dance. // 29
Secondly, she was worshipped by Brahmā, who was terrified of Madhu and Kaiṭabha; / thirdly, by the enemy of Tripura [Śiva], when urged on by Tripura. // 30

2.57.s:
sarvānmokṣaṃ prāpayati janmamṛtyujarādikam ..
carācarāṃśca viśvasthāñcharvāṇī tena kīrtitā .. 17 ..
2.57.d:
सर्वान्मोक्षं प्रापयति जन्ममृत्युजरादिकम् ॥
चराचरांश्च विश्वस्थाञ्छर्वाणी तेन कीर्तिता ॥ 17 ॥

2.57.s:
maṅgalaṃ mokṣavacanaṃ cāśabdo dātṛvācakaḥ ..
sarvānmokṣānyā dadāti saiva syātsarvamaṅgalā .. 18 ..
2.57.d:
मङ्गलं मोक्षवचनं चाशब्दो दातृवाचकः ॥
सर्वान्मोक्षान्या ददाति सैव स्यात्सर्वमङ्गला ॥ 18 ॥

2.57.s:
harṣe sampadi kalyāṇe maṃgalaṃ parikīrtitam ..
tāndadāti ca sarvebhyastena sā sarvamaṃgalā ..19..
2.57.d:
हर्षे सम्पदि कल्याणे मंगलं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
तान्ददाति च सर्वेभ्यस्तेन सा सर्वमंगला ॥19॥

2.57.s:
ambeti mātṛvacano vandane pūjane sadā ..
pūjitā vanditā mātā jagatāṃ tena sā'mbikā .. 2.57.20 ..
2.57.d:
अम्बेति मातृवचनो वन्दने पूजने सदा ॥
पूजिता वन्दिता माता जगतां तेन साऽम्बिका ॥ 2.57.20 ॥

2.57.s:
viṣṇubhaktā viṣṇurūpā viṣṇoḥ śaktisvarūpiṇī ..
sṛṣṭau ca viṣṇunā sṛṣṭā vaiṣṇavī tena kīrtitā .. 21 ..
2.57.d:
विष्णुभक्ता विष्णुरूपा विष्णोः शक्तिस्वरूपिणी ॥
सृष्टौ च विष्णुना सृष्टा वैष्णवी तेन कीर्तिता ॥ 21 ॥

2.57.s:
gauraḥ pīte ca nirlipte pare brahmaṇi nirmale ..
tasyātmanaḥ śaktiriyaṃ gaurī tena prakīrtitā .. 22 ..
2.57.d:
गौरः पीते च निर्लिप्ते परे ब्रह्मणि निर्मले ॥
तस्यात्मनः शक्तिरियं गौरी तेन प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 22 ॥

2.57.s:
guruḥ śambhuśca sarveṣāṃ tasya śaktiḥ yā satī ..
guruḥ kṛṣṇaśca tanmāyā gaurī tena prakīrttitā .. .. 23 ..
2.57.d:
गुरुः शम्भुश्च सर्वेषां तस्य शक्तिः या सती ॥
गुरुः कृष्णश्च तन्माया गौरी तेन प्रकीर्त्तिता ॥ ॥ 23 ॥

2.57.s:
tithibhede parvabhede kalpabhede'nyabhedake ..
khyātau teṣu ca vikhyātā pārvatī tena kīrtitā .. 24 ..
2.57.d:
तिथिभेदे पर्वभेदे कल्पभेदेऽन्यभेदके ॥
ख्यातौ तेषु च विख्याता पार्वती तेन कीर्तिता ॥ 24 ॥

2.57.s:
mahotsavaviśeṣe ca parvanniti sukīrtitā ..
tasyādhidevī yā sā ca pārvatī parikīrttitā..25..
2.57.d:
महोत्सवविशेषे च पर्वन्निति सुकीर्तिता ॥
तस्याधिदेवी या सा च पार्वती परिकीर्त्तिता॥25॥

2.57.s:
parvatasya sutā devī sā''virbhūtā ca parvate..
parvatādhiṣṭhātṛdevī pārvatī tena kīrttitā .. 26 ..
2.57.d:
पर्वतस्य सुता देवी सा'ऽविर्भूता च पर्वते॥
पर्वताधिष्ठातृदेवी पार्वती तेन कीर्त्तिता ॥ 26 ॥

2.57.s:
sarvakāle sanā prokto vistṛte ca tanīti ca ..
sarvatrasarvakāle ca vidyamānā sanātanī ..27..
2.57.d:
सर्वकाले सना प्रोक्तो विस्तृते च तनीति च ॥
सर्वत्रसर्वकाले च विद्यमाना सनातनी ॥27॥

2.57.s:
arthaḥ ṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca kīrttitaśca mahāmune..
yathāgamaṃ tvaṃ vedoktopākhyānaṃ ca niśāmaya ..28..
2.57.d:
अर्थः षोडशनाम्नां च कीर्त्तितश्च महामुने॥
यथागमं त्वं वेदोक्तोपाख्यानं च निशामय ॥28॥

2.57.s:
prathame pūjitā sā ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā..
vṛndāvane ca sṛṣṭyādau goloke rāsamaṇḍale .. 29 ..
2.57.d:
प्रथमे पूजिता सा च कृष्णेन परमात्मना॥
वृन्दावने च सृष्ट्यादौ गोलोके रासमण्डले ॥ 29 ॥

2.57.s:
madhukaiṭabhabhītena brahmaṇā sā dvitīyataḥ ..
tripurapreritenaiva tṛtīye tripurāriṇā.. .. 2.57.30 ..
2.57.d:
मधुकैटभभीतेन ब्रह्मणा सा द्वितीयतः ॥
त्रिपुरप्रेरितेनैव तृतीये त्रिपुरारिणा॥ ॥ 2.57.30 ॥

2.57.s:
bhraṣṭaśriyā mahendreṇa śāpāddurvāsasaḥ purā ..
caturthe pūjitā devī bhaktyā bhagavatī satī .. 31 ..
2.57.d:
भ्रष्टश्रिया महेन्द्रेण शापाद्दुर्वाससः पुरा ॥
चतुर्थे पूजिता देवी भक्त्या भगवती सती ॥ 31 ॥
2.57.m:
Fourthly, when his fortune had fallen through the curse of Durvāsas, / the goddess, Bhagavatī Satī, was worshipped in the past with devotion by Mahendra. // 31
Then by the lords of sages, the lords of siddhas, the gods, and the foremost sages / she was worshipped in all the worlds, and became worshipped everywhere always. // 32
From the energies of all the gods she manifested of old, O sage; / all the gods gave her weapons and ornaments. // 33
Demons such as Durgamasura were slain by that Durgā; / their own kingdom was given to the gods, along with whatever boon they desired. // 34
In another kalpa she was worshipped by the great-souled Suratha, / the king who was a disciple of Medhas, in an earthen image on the bank of a river. // 35
With rams and other beasts, buffaloes, blackbucks, frogs, / goats, sugarcane, gourds, birds, and offerings, O sage, // 36
and having thus offered the sixteen services prescribed in the Veda, / having meditated, donned the armour, and worshipped her according to the rules, // 37
the king, having made circumambulation, obtained the boon as he desired; / and the vaiśya attained liberation having worshipped on the riverbank. // 38
The king and the vaiśya, with tears in their eyes and palms joined, praised her; / he immersed that earthen image indeed in the deep, clear water. // 39
Not seeing that earthen image washed away by the water, the king / and the vaiśya wept then, and then departed to another place. // 40
Having abandoned his body at Puṣkara, having performed severe asceticism, // 41
the vaiśya went to Goloka by the boon of the goddess Durgā. / The king, mighty and worthy of worship, returned to his own kingdom free from rivals, // 42
and the ruler of the earth enjoyed pleasures for sixty thousand years. / Having entrusted his wife and his own kingdom to his son in the course of time, // 43
he performed asceticism at Puṣkara and became the Manu Sāvarṇi. / Thus, my child, has the account of Durgā been told in brief according to tradition, // 44
O best of sages. What more do you wish to hear?

2.57.s:
tadā munīndraiḥ siddhendrairdevaiśca munipuṅgavaiḥ ..
pūjitā sarvaviśveṣu samabhūtsarvataḥ sadā .. 32 ..
2.57.d:
तदा मुनीन्द्रैः सिद्धेन्द्रैर्देवैश्च मुनिपुङ्गवैः ॥
पूजिता सर्वविश्वेषु समभूत्सर्वतः सदा ॥ 32 ॥

2.57.s:
tejassu sarvadevānāṃ sā''virbhūtā purā mune ..
sarve devā dadustasyai śastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca .. 33 ..
2.57.d:
तेजस्सु सर्वदेवानां सा'ऽविर्भूता पुरा मुने ॥
सर्वे देवा ददुस्तस्यै शस्त्राण्याभरणानि च ॥ 33 ॥

2.57.s:
durgādayaśca daityāśca nihatā durgayā tayā ..
dattaṃ svarājyaṃ devebhyo varaṃ ca yadabhīpsitam .. .. 34 ..
2.57.d:
दुर्गादयश्च दैत्याश्च निहता दुर्गया तया ॥
दत्तं स्वराज्यं देवेभ्यो वरं च यदभीप्सितम् ॥ ॥ 34 ॥

2.57.s:
kalpāntare pūjitā sā surathena mahātmanā ..
rājñā ca medhaśiṣyeṇa mṛnmayyāṃ ca sarittaṭe .. 35 ..
2.57.d:
कल्पान्तरे पूजिता सा सुरथेन महात्मना ॥
राज्ञा च मेधशिष्येण मृन्मय्यां च सरित्तटे ॥ 35 ॥

2.57.s:
meṣādibhiśca mahiṣaiḥ kṛṣṇasāraiśca maṇḍakaiḥ ..
chāgairikṣusukūṣmāṇḍaiḥ pakṣibhirbalibhirmune .. 36 ..
2.57.d:
मेषादिभिश्च महिषैः कृष्णसारैश्च मण्डकैः ॥
छागैरिक्षुसुकूष्माण्डैः पक्षिभिर्बलिभिर्मुने ॥ 36 ॥

2.57.s:
vedoktāṃścaiva dattvaivamupacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa ..
dhyātvā ca kavacaṃ dhṛtvā saṃpūjya ca vidhānataḥ .. 37 ..
2.57.d:
वेदोक्तांश्चैव दत्त्वैवमुपचारांस्तु षोडश ॥
ध्यात्वा च कवचं धृत्वा संपूज्य च विधानतः ॥ 37 ॥

2.57.s:
rājā kṛtvā parīhāraṃ varaṃ prāpa yathepsitam ..
muktiṃ saṃprāpa vaiśyaśca saṃpūjya ca sarittaṭe ..38..
2.57.d:
राजा कृत्वा परीहारं वरं प्राप यथेप्सितम् ॥
मुक्तिं संप्राप वैश्यश्च संपूज्य च सरित्तटे ॥38॥

2.57.s:
tuṣṭāva rājā vaiśyaśca sāśrunetraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ ..
sasarja mṛnmayīṃ tāṃ vai gabhīre nirmale jale ..39..
2.57.d:
तुष्टाव राजा वैश्यश्च साश्रुनेत्रः कृताञ्जलिः ॥
ससर्ज मृन्मयीं तां वै गभीरे निर्मले जले ॥39॥

2.57.s:
mṛnmayīṃ tāmadṛṣṭvā ca jaladhautāṃ narādhipaḥ ..
ruroda ca tadā vaiśyastataḥ sthānāntaraṃ yayau .. 2.57.40 ..
2.57.d:
मृन्मयीं तामदृष्ट्वा च जलधौतां नराधिपः ॥
रुरोद च तदा वैश्यस्ततः स्थानान्तरं ययौ ॥ 2.57.40 ॥

2.57.s: tyaktvā dehaṃ ca vaiśyastu puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ .. 41 ..
2.57.d: त्यक्त्वा देहं च वैश्यस्तु पुष्करे दुष्करं तपः ॥ 41 ॥

2.57.s:
kṛtvā jagāma golokaṃ durgādevīvareṇa saḥ ..
rājā yayau svarājyaṃ ca pūjyo niṣkaṇṭakaṃ balī .. 42 ..
2.57.d:
कृत्वा जगाम गोलोकं दुर्गादेवीवरेण सः ॥
राजा ययौ स्वराज्यं च पूज्यो निष्कण्टकं बली ॥ 42 ॥

2.57.s:
bhogaṃ ca bubhuje bhūpaḥ ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrakam ..
bhāryāṃ svarājyaṃ saṃnyasya putre vai kālayogataḥ ..43..
2.57.d:
भोगं च बुभुजे भूपः षष्टिवर्षसहस्रकम् ॥
भार्यां स्वराज्यं संन्यस्य पुत्रे वै कालयोगतः ॥43॥

2.57.s:
manurbabhūva sāvarṇistaptvā vai puṣkare tapaḥ ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa samāsena yathāgamam..44..
2.57.d:
मनुर्बभूव सावर्णिस्तप्त्वा वै पुष्करे तपः ॥
इत्येवं कथितं वत्स समासेन यथागमम्॥44॥

2.57.s: durgākhyānaṃ muniśreṣṭha kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi..91.
2.57.d: दुर्गाख्यानं मुनिश्रेष्ठ किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥91.

2.58.s:
nārada uvāca..
kasya vaṃśodbhavo rājā suratho dharmiṇāṃ varaḥ..
kathaṃ saṃprāpa vai jñānaṃ medhaso jñānināṃ varāt..1..
2.58.d:
नारद उवाच॥
कस्य वंशोद्भवो राजा सुरथो धर्मिणां वरः॥
कथं संप्राप वै ज्ञानं मेधसो ज्ञानिनां वरात्॥1॥

2.58.s:
kasya vaṃśodbhavo brahmanmedhaso munisattama..
babhūva kutra saṃvādo nṛpasya muninā saha..2..
2.58.d:
कस्य वंशोद्भवो ब्रह्मन्मेधसो मुनिसत्तम॥
बभूव कुत्र संवादो नृपस्य मुनिना सह॥2॥

2.58.s:
sakhyaṃ babhūva kutrāsya vā prabho nṛpavaiśyayoḥ..
vyāsena śrotumicchāmi vada vedavidāṃ vara ..3..
2.58.d:
सख्यं बभूव कुत्रास्य वा प्रभो नृपवैश्ययोः॥
व्यासेन श्रोतुमिच्छामि वद वेदविदां वर ॥3॥

2.58.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
atriśca brahmaṇaḥ putrastasya putro niśākaraḥ ..
sa ca kṛtvā rājasūyaṃ dvijarājo babhūva ha .. 4 ..
2.58.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
अत्रिश्च ब्रह्मणः पुत्रस्तस्य पुत्रो निशाकरः ॥
स च कृत्वा राजसूयं द्विजराजो बभूव ह ॥ 4 ॥

2.58.s:
gurupatnyāṃ ca tārāyāṃ tasyābhūcca budhaḥ sutaḥ ..
budhaputrastu caitraśca tatputraḥ surathaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 5 ..
2.58.d:
गुरुपत्न्यां च तारायां तस्याभूच्च बुधः सुतः ॥
बुधपुत्रस्तु चैत्रश्च तत्पुत्रः सुरथः स्मृतः ॥ 5 ॥

2.58.s:
nārada uvāca ..
gurupatnyāṃ ca tārāyāṃ samabhūttatsutaḥ katham..
aho vyatikramaṃ brūhi vedasya ca mahāmune .. 6 ..
2.58.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
गुरुपत्न्यां च तारायां समभूत्तत्सुतः कथम्॥
अहो व्यतिक्रमं ब्रूहि वेदस्य च महामुने ॥ 6 ॥

2.58.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
sampanmatto mahākāmī vyacarajjāhnavītaṭe ..
tārāṃ suraguroḥ patnīṃ dharmiṣṭhāṃ ca pativratām .. 7 ..
2.58.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
सम्पन्मत्तो महाकामी व्यचरज्जाह्नवीतटे ॥
तारां सुरगुरोः पत्नीं धर्मिष्ठां च पतिव्रताम् ॥ 7 ॥

2.58.s:
susnātāṃ sundarīṃ ramyāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām ..
suśroṇīṃ sunitambāḍhyāṃ madhyakṣīṇāṃ manoharām .. 8 ..
2.58.d:
सुस्नातां सुन्दरीं रम्यां पीनोन्नतपयोधराम् ॥
सुश्रोणीं सुनितम्बाढ्यां मध्यक्षीणां मनोहराम् ॥ 8 ॥

2.58.s:
sudatīṃ komalāṃgīṃ ca navayauvanasaṃyutām ..
sūkṣmavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām .. 9 ..
2.58.d:
सुदतीं कोमलांगीं च नवयौवनसंयुताम् ॥
सूक्ष्मवस्त्रपरीधानां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् ॥ 9 ॥

2.58.s:
kastūrībindunā sārddhamadhaścandanabindunā ..
sindūrabindunā cāruphālamadhyasthalojjvalām .. 2.58.10 ..
2.58.d:
कस्तूरीबिन्दुना सार्द्धमधश्चन्दनबिन्दुना ॥
सिन्दूरबिन्दुना चारुफालमध्यस्थलोज्ज्वलाम् ॥ 2.58.10 ॥

2.58.s:
vāyunā'dhovastrahīnāṃ sakāmāṃ raktalocanām ..
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ pakvabimbādharāṃ varām .. 11 ..
2.58.d:
वायुनाऽधोवस्त्रहीनां सकामां रक्तलोचनाम् ॥
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रास्यां पक्वबिम्बाधरां वराम् ॥ 11 ॥
2.58.m: with a face like the autumn full moon, with lips like ripe bimba fruit, the best of women, (11)

2.58.s:
sasmitāṃ namnavaktrāṃ ca lajjayā candradarśanām ..
gacchantīṃ svagṛhaṃ harṣānmattavāraṇagāminīm .. 12 ..
2.58.d:
सस्मितां नम्नवक्त्रां च लज्जया चन्द्रदर्शनाम् ॥
गच्छन्तीं स्वगृहं हर्षान्मत्तवारणगामिनीम् ॥ 12 ॥
2.58.m: smiling, with face lowered in modesty at the sight of the Moon,

2.58.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manmathākrāntaścandro lajjāṃ jahau mune ..
pulakāṃkitasarvāṅgaḥ sakāmastāmuvāca saḥ .. 13 ..
2.58.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा मन्मथाक्रान्तश्चन्द्रो लज्जां जहौ मुने ॥
पुलकांकितसर्वाङ्गः सकामस्तामुवाच सः ॥ 13 ॥

2.58.s:
candra uvāca ..
yoṣicchreṣṭhe kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha variṣṭhe rasikāsu ca ..
suvidagdhe vidagdhānāṃ mano harasi santatam .. 14 ..
2.58.d:
चन्द्र उवाच ॥
योषिच्छ्रेष्ठे क्षणं तिष्ठ वरिष्ठे रसिकासु च ॥
सुविदग्धे विदग्धानां मनो हरसि सन्ततम् ॥ 14 ॥

2.58.s:
niṣevya prakṛtiṃ janmasahasre kāmasāgare ..
tapaḥphalena tvāṃ prāpa bṛhacchroṇīṃ bṛhaspatiḥ .. 15 ..
2.58.d:
निषेव्य प्रकृतिं जन्मसहस्रे कामसागरे ॥
तपःफलेन त्वां प्राप बृहच्छ्रोणीं बृहस्पतिः ॥ 15 ॥

2.58.s:
aho tapasvinā sārddhamavidagdhena vedhasā ..
yojitā tvaṃ rasavatī śaśvatkāmāturā varā .. 16 ..
2.58.d:
अहो तपस्विना सार्द्धमविदग्धेन वेधसा ॥
योजिता त्वं रसवती शश्वत्कामातुरा वरा ॥ 16 ॥

2.58.s:
kiṃ vā sukhaṃ ca vijñātamavijñeṣu samāgame ..
vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamaḥ sukhasāgaraḥ .. 17 ..
2.58.d:
किं वा सुखं च विज्ञातमविज्ञेषु समागमे ॥
विदग्धाया विदग्धेन सङ्गमः सुखसागरः ॥ 17 ॥

2.58.s:
kāmena kāminī tvaṃ ca dagdhā'si vyarthamīśvari ..
karmaṇā vā''tmadoṣādvā ko jānāti manaḥ striyāḥ .. 18 ..
2.58.d:
कामेन कामिनी त्वं च दग्धाऽसि व्यर्थमीश्वरि ॥
कर्मणा वा'ऽत्मदोषाद्वा को जानाति मनः स्त्रियाः ॥ 18 ॥

2.58.s:
dine dine vṛthā yāti durlabhaṃ navayauvanam ..
navīnayauvanasthāyā vṛddhena svāminā tava .. 19 ..
2.58.d:
दिने दिने वृथा याति दुर्लभं नवयौवनम् ॥
नवीनयौवनस्थाया वृद्धेन स्वामिना तव ॥ 19 ॥

2.58.s:
śaśvattapasyāyuktaśca kṛṣṇamātmānamīpsitam ..
svapne jāgaraṇe vā'pi dhyāyannāste bṛhaspatiḥ .. 2.58.20 ..
2.58.d:
शश्वत्तपस्यायुक्तश्च कृष्णमात्मानमीप्सितम् ॥
स्वप्ने जागरणे वाऽपि ध्यायन्नास्ते बृहस्पतिः ॥ 2.58.20 ॥

2.58.s:
sarvakāmarasajñā tvaṃ niṣkāmaṃ kāmamīpsitam ..
dhyāyantī kāmukī śaśvadyūnāṃ śṛṃgāramātmani .. 21 ..
2.58.d:
सर्वकामरसज्ञा त्वं निष्कामं काममीप्सितम् ॥
ध्यायन्ती कामुकी शश्वद्यूनां शृंगारमात्मनि ॥ 21 ॥

2.58.s:
anyaśca tvanmanaḥkāmo bhinnaṃ tvadbharturīpsitam ..
yayośca bhinnau viṣayau kā prītiḥ saṃgame tayoḥ .. 22 ..
2.58.d:
अन्यश्च त्वन्मनःकामो भिन्नं त्वद्भर्तुरीप्सितम् ॥
ययोश्च भिन्नौ विषयौ का प्रीतिः संगमे तयोः ॥ 22 ॥

2.58.s:
vāsantīpuṣpatalpe ca gandhacandana carcite ..
modasva māṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ vasante mādhavīvane .. 23 ..
2.58.d:
वासन्तीपुष्पतल्पे च गन्धचन्दन चर्चिते ॥
मोदस्व मां गृहीत्वा त्वं वसन्ते माधवीवने ॥ 23 ॥

2.58.s:
sugandhyutphullakusume nirjane candane vane ..
bhavatī yuvatī bhāgyavatī tatraiva modatām .. 24 ..
2.58.d:
सुगन्ध्युत्फुल्लकुसुमे निर्जने चन्दने वने ॥
भवती युवती भाग्यवती तत्रैव मोदताम् ॥ 24 ॥

2.58.s:
candane campakavane śītacampakavāyunā ..
ramye campakatalpe ca krīḍāṃ kuru mayā saha .. 25..
ityuktvā madano nmatto madanādhikasundaraḥ ..
papāta caraṇe devyā mando mandākinītaṭe .. 25 ..
niruddhamārgā candreṇa śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā ..
abhītovāca kopena raktapaṃkajalocanā .. 24 ..
2.58.d:
चन्दने चम्पकवने शीतचम्पकवायुना ॥
रम्ये चम्पकतल्पे च क्रीडां कुरु मया सह ॥ 25॥
इत्युक्त्वा मदनो न्मत्तो मदनाधिकसुन्दरः ॥
पपात चरणे देव्या मन्दो मन्दाकिनीतटे ॥ 25 ॥
निरुद्धमार्गा चन्द्रेण शुष्ककण्ठौष्ठतालुका ॥
अभीतोवाच कोपेन रक्तपंकजलोचना ॥ 24 ॥

2.58.s:
tārovāca ..
dhik tvāṃ candra tṛṇaṃ manye parastrīlampaṭaṃ śaṭham ..
atrerabhāgyāttvaṃ putro vyarthaṃ te janma jīvanam .. 28 ..
2.58.d:
तारोवाच ॥
धिक् त्वां चन्द्र तृणं मन्ये परस्त्रीलम्पटं शठम् ॥
अत्रेरभाग्यात्त्वं पुत्रो व्यर्थं ते जन्म जीवनम् ॥ 28 ॥

2.58.s:
are kṛtvā rājasūyamātmānaṃ manyase balī ..
babhūva puṇyaṃ te vyarthaṃ viprastrīṣu ca yanmanaḥ .. 29 ..
2.58.d:
अरे कृत्वा राजसूयमात्मानं मन्यसे बली ॥
बभूव पुण्यं ते व्यर्थं विप्रस्त्रीषु च यन्मनः ॥ 29 ॥

2.58.s:
yasya cittaṃ parastrīṣu so'śuciḥ sarvakarmasu ..
na karmaphalabhākpāpī nindyo viśveṣu sarvataḥ 2.58.30 ..
2.58.d:
यस्य चित्तं परस्त्रीषु सोऽशुचिः सर्वकर्मसु ॥
न कर्मफलभाक्पापी निन्द्यो विश्वेषु सर्वतः 2.58.30 ॥

2.58.s:
satītvaṃ me nāśayasi yakṣmagrasto bhaviṣyasi ..
atyucchrito nipatanaṃ prāpnotīti śrutau śrutam .. 31 ..
2.58.d:
सतीत्वं मे नाशयसि यक्ष्मग्रस्तो भविष्यसि ॥
अत्युच्छ्रितो निपतनं प्राप्नोतीति श्रुतौ श्रुतम् ॥ 31 ॥

2.58.s:
duṣṭānāṃ darpahā kṛṣṇo darpaṃ te nihaniṣyati ..
tyaja māṃ mātaraṃ vatsa satyaṃ te śaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 32 ..
2.58.d:
दुष्टानां दर्पहा कृष्णो दर्पं ते निहनिष्यति ॥
त्यज मां मातरं वत्स सत्यं ते शं भविष्यति ॥ 32 ॥

2.58.s:
ityuktvā tārakā sādhvī ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ ..
cakāra sākṣiṇaṃ dharmaṃ sūryyaṃ vāyuṃ hutāśanam .. 33 ..
2.58.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तारका साध्वी रुरोद च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
चकार साक्षिणं धर्मं सूर्य्यं वायुं हुताशनम् ॥ 33 ॥

2.58.s:
brahmāṇaṃ paramātmānamākāśaṃ pavanaṃ dharām ..
dinaṃ rātriṃ ca sandhyāṃ ca sarvaṃ suragaṇaṃ mune .. 34 ..
2.58.d:
ब्रह्माणं परमात्मानमाकाशं पवनं धराम् ॥
दिनं रात्रिं च सन्ध्यां च सर्वं सुरगणं मुने ॥ 34 ॥

2.58.s:
tārakāvacanaṃ śrutvā na bhītaḥ sa cukopa ha..
kare dhṛtvā rathe tūrṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsa sundarīm ..35..
2.58.d:
तारकावचनं श्रुत्वा न भीतः स चुकोप ह॥
करे धृत्वा रथे तूर्णं स्थापयामास सुन्दरीम् ॥35॥

2.58.s:
rathaṃ ca cālayāmāsa manoyāyī manoharam..
manoharāṃ gṛhītvā tāṃ sa ca reme manoharam .. 36 ..
2.58.d:
रथं च चालयामास मनोयायी मनोहरम्॥
मनोहरां गृहीत्वा तां स च रेमे मनोहरम् ॥ 36 ॥

2.58.s:
vispandake suravane candane puṣpabhadrake ..
puṣkare ca nadītīre puṣpite puṣpakānane ..37..
2.58.d:
विस्पन्दके सुरवने चन्दने पुष्पभद्रके ॥
पुष्करे च नदीतीरे पुष्पिते पुष्पकानने ॥37॥

2.58.s:
sugandhi puṣpatalpe ca puṣpacandanavāyunā ..
nirjane malayadroṇyāṃ snigdhacandanacarcite .. 38 ..
2.58.d:
सुगन्धि पुष्पतल्पे च पुष्पचन्दनवायुना ॥
निर्जने मलयद्रोण्यां स्निग्धचन्दनचर्चिते ॥ 38 ॥

2.58.s:
śaile śaile nade nadyāṃ śṛṃgāraṃ kurvatostayoḥ ..
gataṃ varṣaśataṃ harṣānmuhūrttamiva nārada .. 39 ..
2.58.d:
शैले शैले नदे नद्यां शृंगारं कुर्वतोस्तयोः ॥
गतं वर्षशतं हर्षान्मुहूर्त्तमिव नारद ॥ 39 ॥

2.58.s:
babhūva śaraṇāpanno bhīto daityeṣu candramāḥ ..
tejasvini tathā śukre teṣāṃ ca balināṃ gurau .. 2.58.40 ..
2.58.d:
बभूव शरणापन्नो भीतो दैत्येषु चन्द्रमाः ॥
तेजस्विनि तथा शुक्रे तेषां च बलिनां गुरौ ॥ 2.58.40 ॥

2.58.s:
abhayaṃ ca dadau tasmai kṛpayā bhṛgunandanaḥ ..
guruṃ jahāsa devānāṃ suvipakṣaṃ bṛhaspatim .. 41 ..
2.58.d:
अभयं च ददौ तस्मै कृपया भृगुनन्दनः ॥
गुरुं जहास देवानां सुविपक्षं बृहस्पतिम् ॥ 41 ॥

2.58.s:
sabhāyāṃ jahasurhṛṣṭā balino ditinandanāḥ ..
abhayaṃ ca dadustasmai bhītāya ca kalaṅkine .. 42 ..
2.58.d:
सभायां जहसुर्हृष्टा बलिनो दितिनन्दनाः ॥
अभयं च ददुस्तस्मै भीताय च कलङ्किने ॥ 42 ॥

2.58.s:
satīsatītvadhvaṃsena pāpiṣṭhacandramaṇḍale ..
babhūva śaśarūpaṃ ca kalaṃkaṃ nirmale malam .. 43 ..
2.58.d:
सतीसतीत्वध्वंसेन पापिष्ठचन्द्रमण्डले ॥
बभूव शशरूपं च कलंकं निर्मले मलम् ॥ 43 ॥

2.58.s:
uvāca taṃ mahābhītaṃ śukro vedavidāṃ varaḥ ..
hitaṃ tathyaṃ vedayuktaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham .. 44 ..
2.58.d:
उवाच तं महाभीतं शुक्रो वेदविदां वरः ॥
हितं तथ्यं वेदयुक्तं परिणामसुखावहम् ॥ 44 ॥

2.58.s:
śukra uvāca ..
tvamaho brahmaṇaḥ pautro'pyatrerbhagavataḥ sutaḥ ..
durnītaṃ karma te putra nīcavannayaśaskaram .. 45 ..
2.58.d:
शुक्र उवाच ॥
त्वमहो ब्रह्मणः पौत्रोऽप्यत्रेर्भगवतः सुतः ॥
दुर्नीतं कर्म ते पुत्र नीचवन्नयशस्करम् ॥ 45 ॥

2.58.s:
rājasūyasya suphale nirmale kīrttimaṇḍale ..
sudhārāśau surābindurūpamaṃkamupārjitam .. 46 ..
2.58.d:
राजसूयस्य सुफले निर्मले कीर्त्तिमण्डले ॥
सुधाराशौ सुराबिन्दुरूपमंकमुपार्जितम् ॥ 46 ॥

2.58.s:
tyaja devagurau patnīṃ prasūmiva mahāsatīm ..
dharmiṣṭhasya variṣṭhasya brāhmaṇānāṃ bṛhaspateḥ .. 47 ..
2.58.d:
त्यज देवगुरौ पत्नीं प्रसूमिव महासतीम् ॥
धर्मिष्ठस्य वरिष्ठस्य ब्राह्मणानां बृहस्पतेः ॥ 47 ॥

2.58.s:
śambhoḥ surāṇāmīśasya guruputrasya vedhasaḥ ..
pautrasyāṃgirase nityaṃ jvalato brahmatejasā ..48..
2.58.d:
शम्भोः सुराणामीशस्य गुरुपुत्रस्य वेधसः ॥
पौत्रस्यांगिरसे नित्यं ज्वलतो ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥48॥

2.58.s:
śatrorapi guṇā vācyā doṣā vācyā gurorapi ..
iti sadvaṃśajātānāṃ svabhāvaṃ ca satāmapi ..49..
2.58.d:
शत्रोरपि गुणा वाच्या दोषा वाच्या गुरोरपि ॥
इति सद्वंशजातानां स्वभावं च सतामपि ॥49॥

2.58.s:
sa śatrurme suraguruḥ paro viśve niśākara ..
tathā'pi sahajākhyānaṃ varṇitaṃ dharmasaṃsadi ..
yatra lokāśca dharmiṣṭhāstatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ .. .. 2.58.50 ..
2.58.d:
स शत्रुर्मे सुरगुरुः परो विश्वे निशाकर ॥
तथाऽपि सहजाख्यानं वर्णितं धर्मसंसदि ॥
यत्र लोकाश्च धर्मिष्ठास्तत्र धर्मः सनातनः ॥ ॥ 2.58.50 ॥
2.58.m: Where people are righteous, there is eternal dharma.

2.58.s:
yato dharmastataḥ kṛṣṇo yataḥ kṛṣṇastato jayaḥ ..
gaurekaṃ pañca ca vyāghrī siṃhī sapta prasūyate .. 51 ..
2.58.d:
यतो धर्मस्ततः कृष्णो यतः कृष्णस्ततो जयः ॥
गौरेकं पञ्च च व्याघ्री सिंही सप्त प्रसूयते ॥ 51 ॥
2.58.m:
Where there is dharma, there is Kṛṣṇa; where there is Kṛṣṇa, there is victory.
A cow gives birth to one, a tigress to five, a lioness to seven;

2.58.s:
hiṃsakāḥ pralayaṃ yānti dharmo rakṣati dhārmikam ..
devāśca guravo viprāḥ śaktā yadyapi rakṣitum ..52..
2.58.d:
हिंसकाः प्रलयं यान्ति धर्मो रक्षति धार्मिकम् ॥
देवाश्च गुरवो विप्राः शक्ता यद्यपि रक्षितुम् ॥52॥
2.58.m:
harmful creatures go to destruction, while dharma protects the righteous person.
Although gods, gurus, and brāhmaṇas are capable of protecting,

2.58.s:
tathā'pi nahi rakṣanti dharmaghnaṃ pāpinaṃ janam..
kulaṭā viprapatnīnāṃ gamane suraviprayoḥ .. 53 ..
2.58.d:
तथाऽपि नहि रक्षन्ति धर्मघ्नं पापिनं जनम्॥
कुलटा विप्रपत्नीनां गमने सुरविप्रयोः ॥ 53 ॥
2.58.m:
still they do not protect a sinful person who destroys dharma.
If a god or a brāhmaṇa visits unchaste wives of brāhmaṇas,

2.58.s:
brahmahatyāṣoḍaśāṃśa pātakaṃ ca bhaveddhruvam ..
tāsāmupasthitānāṃ ca gamane taccaturthakam .. 54 ..
2.58.d:
ब्रह्महत्याषोडशांश पातकं च भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥
तासामुपस्थितानां च गमने तच्चतुर्थकम् ॥ 54 ॥
2.58.m:
the sin is surely a sixteenth part of the killing of a brāhmaṇa.
If he visits them when they have offered themselves, it is a fourth of that.

2.58.s:
viprapatnīsatīnāṃ ca gamanaṃ vai balena cet ..
brahmahatyāśataṃ pāpaṃ bhavedeva śrutau śrutam .. 55 ..
2.58.d:
विप्रपत्नीसतीनां च गमनं वै बलेन चेत् ॥
ब्रह्महत्याशतं पापं भवेदेव श्रुतौ श्रुतम् ॥ 55 ॥
2.58.m:
If, however, there is forcible union with chaste wives of brāhmaṇas,
the sin is indeed equal to a hundred killings of a brāhmaṇa—so it is heard in the Veda.

2.58.s:
dharmmaṃ cara mahābhāga brāhmaṇīṃ tyaja sāmpratam ..
kṛtvā'nutāpaṃ pāpācca nivṛttistu mahāphalā .. 56 ..
2.58.d:
धर्म्मं चर महाभाग ब्राह्मणीं त्यज साम्प्रतम् ॥
कृत्वाऽनुतापं पापाच्च निवृत्तिस्तु महाफला ॥ 56 ॥
2.58.m:
Practice dharma, O fortunate one! Release the brāhmaṇa's wife at once!"
Repenting and desisting from sin yields great fruit;

2.58.s:
upāyena ca te pāpaṃ dūrībhūtaṃ bhavennanu ..
śaraṇāgata bhītasya mayi devasya dharmataḥ .. 57 ..
2.58.d:
उपायेन च ते पापं दूरीभूतं भवेन्ननु ॥
शरणागत भीतस्य मयि देवस्य धर्मतः ॥ 57 ॥
2.58.m:
and by an expedient, your sin will surely be dispelled.
Since you, a god, have sought refuge in me in fright, by duty,

2.58.s:
śastrahīnaṃ ca bhītaṃ ca dīnaṃ ca śaraṇārthinam ..
yo na rakṣatyadharmiṣṭhaḥ kumbhīpāke vaseddhruvam.. . .. 58 ..
2.58.d:
शस्त्रहीनं च भीतं च दीनं च शरणार्थिनम् ॥
यो न रक्षत्यधर्मिष्ठः कुम्भीपाके वसेद्ध्रुवम्॥ ॥। 58 ॥
2.58.m:
he who does not protect one weaponless, terrified, miserable, / and seeking refuge—
that most unrighteous man shall surely dwell in Kumbhīpāka.

2.58.s:
rājasūyaśatānāṃ ca rakṣitā labhate phalam ..
paramaiśvaryyayuktaśca dharmeṇa sa bhavediha .. 59 ..
2.58.d:
राजसूयशतानां च रक्षिता लभते फलम् ॥
परमैश्वर्य्ययुक्तश्च धर्मेण स भवेदिह ॥ 59 ॥
2.58.m:
And he who protects [such a one] obtains the fruit of a hundred Rājasūya sacrifices;
he becomes endowed with supreme sovereignty through righteousness here in this world.”

2.58.s:
ityuktvā vai daityaguruḥ svarge mandākinītaṭe ..
snātvā taṃ snāpayāmāsa viṣṇupūjāṃ cakāra saḥ .. 2.58.60 ..
2.58.d:
इत्युक्त्वा वै दैत्यगुरुः स्वर्गे मन्दाकिनीतटे ॥
स्नात्वा तं स्नापयामास विष्णुपूजां चकार सः ॥ 2.58.60 ॥
2.58.m:
Having said this in heaven on the bank of the Mandākinī, the guru of the Daityas
bathed, made him bathe, and performed Viṣṇu's worship.

2.58.s:
viṣṇupādābjajātena tannaivedyaṃ śubhapradam ..
gaṃgodakena puṇyena bhojayāmāsa candrakam ..61..
2.58.d:
विष्णुपादाब्जजातेन तन्नैवेद्यं शुभप्रदम् ॥
गंगोदकेन पुण्येन भोजयामास चन्द्रकम् ॥61॥
2.58.m:
With the sacred water of the Gaṅgā, produced from Viṣṇu’s lotus feet,
he caused Candra to consume that naivedya offering that grants good fortune.

2.58.s:
kroḍe kṛtvā tu taṃ bhītaṃ sajjitaṃ pāpakarmaṇā ..
kuśahastastamityūce smāraṃsmāraṃ hariṃ mune .. .. 62 ..
2.58.d:
क्रोडे कृत्वा तु तं भीतं सज्जितं पापकर्मणा ॥
कुशहस्तस्तमित्यूचे स्मारंस्मारं हरिं मुने ॥ ॥ 62 ॥
2.58.m:
Taking into his lap the frightened [god] who was burdened by his sinful deed,
with kuśa grass in hand, remembering Hari repeatedly, he spoke thus to him, O sage:

2.58.s:
śukra uvāca ..
yadyasti me tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ pūjāphalaṃ hare ..
satyaṃ vrataphalaṃ caiva satyaṃ satyavacaḥ phalam .. 63 ..
2.58.d:
शुक्र उवाच ॥
यद्यस्ति मे तपः सत्यं सत्यं पूजाफलं हरे ॥
सत्यं व्रतफलं चैव सत्यं सत्यवचः फलम् ॥ 63 ॥
2.58.m:
“If my austerity is true, if the fruit of Hari’s worship is true,
if the fruit of vows is indeed true, and the fruit of true speech is true;

2.58.s:
tīrthasnānaphalaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ dānaphalaṃ yadi ..
upavāsaphalaṃ satyaṃ pāpānmukto bhavānbhavet .. 64 ..
2.58.d:
तीर्थस्नानफलं सत्यं सत्यं दानफलं यदि ॥
उपवासफलं सत्यं पापान्मुक्तो भवान्भवेत् ॥ 64 ॥
2.58.m:
if the fruit of bathing at sacred shrines is true, if the fruit of giving is true,
and the fruit of fasting is true—may you be freed from sin!

2.58.s:
vipraṃ trisandhyāhīnaṃ yā viṣṇupūjāvihī nakam ..
tannāpnotu mahāghoraṃ candrapāpaṃ sudāruṇam .. 65 ..
2.58.d:
विप्रं त्रिसन्ध्याहीनं या विष्णुपूजाविही नकम् ॥
तन्नाप्नोतु महाघोरं चन्द्रपापं सुदारुणम् ॥ 65 ॥
2.58.m:
May the extremely frightful and most terrible sin of Candra
fall upon the Brahmin who lacks the three daily twilights’ prayers and is devoid of Viṣṇu’s worship!

2.58.s:
svabhāryyāvañcanaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ prayāti parastriyam ..
sa yātu narakaṃ ghoraṃ rudrapāpena pātakī ..66..
2.58.d:
स्वभार्य्यावञ्चनं कृत्वा यः प्रयाति परस्त्रियम् ॥
स यातु नरकं घोरं रुद्रपापेन पातकी ॥66॥
2.58.m:
He who, having deceived his own wife, goes to another’s wife—
let that sinner go to dreadful hell by the sin of [the enemy of] Rudra!

2.58.s:
vācā vā tāḍayetkāntaṃ duśśīlā durmukhā ca yā ..
sā yugaṃ candrapāpena yātu lālāmukhaṃ dhruvam ..67..
2.58.d:
वाचा वा ताडयेत्कान्तं दुश्शीला दुर्मुखा च या ॥
सा युगं चन्द्रपापेन यातु लालामुखं ध्रुवम् ॥67॥
2.58.m:
She who is ill-behaved and foul-mouthed, and strikes her husband with words—
let her surely go to Lālāmukha for a yuga through Candra’s sin!

2.58.s:
anaivedyaṃ vṛthānnaṃ ca yaśca bhuṅkte harerdvijaḥ ..
sa yātu kālasūtraṃ ca candrapāpāccaturyugam .. 68 ..
2.58.d:
अनैवेद्यं वृथान्नं च यश्च भुङ्क्ते हरेर्द्विजः ॥
स यातु कालसूत्रं च चन्द्रपापाच्चतुर्युगम् ॥ 68 ॥
2.58.m:
Whatever twice-born man eats food that is not an offering to Hari and is prepared in vain—
let him go to Kālasūtra for four yugas through Candra’s sin!

2.58.s:
ambuvācyaṃ bhūkhananaṃ yaḥ karoti narā dhamaḥ ..
candrapāpādyugaśataṃ kālasūtraṃ sa gacchatu .. 69 ..
2.58.d:
अम्बुवाच्यं भूखननं यः करोति नरा धमः ॥
चन्द्रपापाद्युगशतं कालसूत्रं स गच्छतु ॥ 69 ॥
2.58.m:
The vile man who digs the earth during the Ambubācī period—
let him go to Kālasūtra for a hundred yugas through Candra’s sin!

2.58.s:
svakāntaṃ vañcayitvā ca yā yāti parapūruṣam ..
sā yātu vahnikuṇḍaṃ ca candrapāpāccaturyugam .. 2.58.70 ..
2.58.d:
स्वकान्तं वञ्चयित्वा च या याति परपूरुषम् ॥
सा यातु वह्निकुण्डं च चन्द्रपापाच्चतुर्युगम् ॥ 2.58.70 ॥
2.58.m:
She who, having deceived her own husband, goes to another man—
let her go to the Pit of Fire for four yugas through Candra’s sin!

2.58.s:
kīrttiṃ karoti rajasā parakīrttiṃ vilupya ca ..
sa yugaṃ candrapāpena kumbhīpākaṃ ca gacchatu .. 71 ..
2.58.d:
कीर्त्तिं करोति रजसा परकीर्त्तिं विलुप्य च ॥
स युगं चन्द्रपापेन कुम्भीपाकं च गच्छतु ॥ 71 ॥
2.58.m:
He who aggressively makes a reputation for himself by obliterating the fame of another—
let him go to Kumbhīpāka for a yuga through Candra’s sin!

2.58.s:
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bhāryyāṃ yo na puṣṇāti pātakī ..
svaguruṃ candrapāpena yātu caṇḍālatāṃ dhruvam .. 72 ..
2.58.d:
पितरं मातरं भार्य्यां यो न पुष्णाति पातकी ॥
स्वगुरुं चन्द्रपापेन यातु चण्डालतां ध्रुवम् ॥ 72 ॥
2.58.m:
The sinner who does not support his father, mother, wife,
or his guru—let him surely attain the status of a caṇḍāla through Candra’s sin!

2.58.s:
kulaṭānnamavīrānnamṛtusnātānnameva ca ..
yo'śnāti candrapāpaṃ ca yātu taṃ pāpinaṃ dhruvam ..73..
2.58.d:
कुलटान्नमवीरान्नमृतुस्नातान्नमेव च ॥
योऽश्नाति चन्द्रपापं च यातु तं पापिनं ध्रुवम् ॥73॥
2.58.m:
He who eats the food of an unchaste woman, of a woman without husband or son, or of a woman bathed after her menses—
let Candra’s sin surely go to that sinner!

2.58.s:
sa yātu tena pāpena kumbhīpākaṃ caturyugam ..
tasmāduttīryya cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāpnoti pātakī .. 74 ..
2.58.d:
स यातु तेन पापेन कुम्भीपाकं चतुर्युगम् ॥
तस्मादुत्तीर्य्य चाण्डालीं योनिमाप्नोति पातकी ॥ 74 ॥
2.58.m: Through that sin, let him go to Kumbhīpāka for four yugas;

2.58.s:
divase yo grāmyadharmaṃ mahāpāpī karoti ca ..
yo gacchetkāmataḥ kāmī gurviṇīṃ vā rajasvalām .. 75 ..
2.58.d:
दिवसे यो ग्राम्यधर्मं महापापी करोति च ॥
यो गच्छेत्कामतः कामी गुर्विणीं वा रजस्वलाम् ॥ 75 ॥
2.58.m:
The great sinner who engages in sexual intercourse by day,
or the lustful man who lustfully approaches a pregnant or menstruating woman—

2.58.s:
taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca mahāghoraṃ ca pāpinam ..
sa yātu tena pāpena kālasūtraṃ caturyugam ..76..
2.58.d:
तं यातु चन्द्रपापं च महाघोरं च पापिनम् ॥
स यातु तेन पापेन कालसूत्रं चतुर्युगम् ॥76॥
2.58.m:
let Candra’s greatly terrifying sin go to that sinner!
Through that sin, let him go to Kālasūtra for four yugas.

2.58.s:
mukhaṃ śroṇīṃ stanaṃ cāpi yaḥ paśyati parastriyāḥ ..
kāmataḥ kāmadagdhaśca yātu taṃ candrakalmaṣam ..77..
2.58.d:
मुखं श्रोणीं स्तनं चापि यः पश्यति परस्त्रियाः ॥
कामतः कामदग्धश्च यातु तं चन्द्रकल्मषम् ॥77॥
2.58.m:
He who gazes lustfully, burned by passion, upon the face,
hips, or breasts of another’s wife—let Candra’s stain go to him!

2.58.s:
sa yātu lālābhakṣaṃ ca candrapāpāccaturyugam ..
tasmāduttīryya bhavatu cāṇḍālo'ndho napuṃsakaḥ .. 78 ..
2.58.d:
स यातु लालाभक्षं च चन्द्रपापाच्चतुर्युगम् ॥
तस्मादुत्तीर्य्य भवतु चाण्डालोऽन्धो नपुंसकः ॥ 78 ॥
2.58.m:
Let him go to Lālābhakṣa for four yugas through Candra’s sin;
emerging from there, let him become a blind, impotent caṇḍāla!

2.58.s:
kuhūpūrṇendusaṃkrānticaturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca ..
māṃsaṃ masūraṃ lakucaṃ yaśca bhukṅte raverdine .. 71 ..
2.58.d:
कुहूपूर्णेन्दुसंक्रान्तिचतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च ॥
मांसं मसूरं लकुचं यश्च भुक्ङ्ते रवेर्दिने ॥ 71 ॥
2.58.m: and on the day of the Sun, he who eats meat, lentils, or monkey-jack fruit,

2.58.s:
kurute grāmyadharmaṃ ca yātu taṃ candrakilbiṣam ..
caturyugaṃ kālasūtraṃ tena pāpena gacchatu .. 2.58.80 ..
2.58.d:
कुरुते ग्राम्यधर्मं च यातु तं चन्द्रकिल्बिषम् ॥
चतुर्युगं कालसूत्रं तेन पापेन गच्छतु ॥ 2.58.80 ॥
2.58.m:
and engages in sexual intercourse—let Candra’s transgression go to him!
Through that sin, let him go to Kālasūtra for four yugas;

2.58.s:
tasmāduttīryya cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāpnoti pātakī ..
saptajanmasu sadrogī daridraḥ kubja eva ca ..81..
2.58.d:
तस्मादुत्तीर्य्य चाण्डालीं योनिमाप्नोति पातकी ॥
सप्तजन्मसु सद्रोगी दरिद्रः कुब्ज एव च ॥81॥
2.58.m: and remains chronically diseased, impoverished, and hunchbacked for seven births.

2.58.s:
ekādaśyāṃ ca yo bhuṅkte kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīdine..
śivarātrau mahāpāpī yātu taṃ candrapātakam .. 82 ..
2.58.d:
एकादश्यां च यो भुङ्क्ते कृष्णजन्माष्टमीदिने॥
शिवरात्रौ महापापी यातु तं चन्द्रपातकम् ॥ 82 ॥
2.58.m:
The great sinner who eats on Ekādaśī, on the day of Kṛṣṇa’s birth (Janmāṣṭamī),
or on Śivarātri—let Candra’s sin go to him!

2.58.s:
sa yātu kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ..
tena pāpena cāpnotu cāṇḍālīṃ yonimeva ca .. 83 ..
2.58.d:
स यातु कुम्भीपाकं च यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ॥
तेन पापेन चाप्नोतु चाण्डालीं योनिमेव च ॥ 83 ॥
2.58.m:
Let him go to Kumbhīpāka for as long as fourteen Indras rule,
and through that sin, let him attain the womb of a caṇḍāla woman.

2.58.s:
tāmrasthaṃ dugdhamādhvīkamucchiṣṭe ghṛtameva ca ..
nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye dugdhaṃ salavaṇaṃ tathā .. 84 ..
2.58.d:
ताम्रस्थं दुग्धमाध्वीकमुच्छिष्टे घृतमेव च ॥
नारिकेलोदकं कांस्ये दुग्धं सलवणं तथा ॥ 84 ॥
2.58.m:
Milk kept in copper, wine, ghee kept in defiled food,
coconut water in bell-metal, salted milk,

2.58.s:
pītaśeṣa jalaṃ caiva bhuktaśeṣaṃ tathaudanam ..
asakṛccaudanaṃ bhuṅkte sūryye nāstaṃ gate dvijaḥ .. 85 ..
2.58.d:
पीतशेष जलं चैव भुक्तशेषं तथौदनम् ॥
असकृच्चौदनं भुङ्क्ते सूर्य्ये नास्तं गते द्विजः ॥ 85 ॥
2.58.m:
water left over from drinking, and boiled rice left over from eating;
the twice-born man who repeatedly eats boiled rice before the sun has set—

2.58.s:
taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca durnivāraṃ ca dāruṇam ..
sa yātu tena pāpena cāndhakūpaṃ caturyugam .. 86 ..
2.58.d:
तं यातु चन्द्रपापं च दुर्निवारं च दारुणम् ॥
स यातु तेन पापेन चान्धकूपं चतुर्युगम् ॥ 86 ॥
2.58.m:
May the dreadful and irresistible sin of Candra go to him;
may he go, by that sin, to Andhakūpa for four yugas. // 86

2.58.s:
svakanyāvikrayī vipro devalo vṛṣavāhakaḥ ..
śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca teṣāṃ vai sūpakārakaḥ .. 87 ..
2.58.d:
स्वकन्याविक्रयी विप्रो देवलो वृषवाहकः ॥
शूद्राणां शवदाही च तेषां वै सूपकारकः ॥ 87 ॥
2.58.m:
A brahmin who sells his own daughter, a temple-priest, one who rides a bull,
one who burns the corpses of Śūdras, and indeed one who cooks for them, // 87

2.58.s:
aśvatthatarughātī ca viṣṇuvaiṣṇavanindakaḥ ..
taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca dāruṇaṃ pāpinaṃ bhṛśam .. .. 88 ..
2.58.d:
अश्वत्थतरुघाती च विष्णुवैष्णवनिन्दकः ॥
तं यातु चन्द्रपापं च दारुणं पापिनं भृशम् ॥ ॥ 88 ॥
2.58.m:
one who cuts down an aśvattha tree, and a reviler of Viṣṇu and Vaiṣṇavas—
may the dreadful sin of Candra go to that sinner exceedingly. // 88

2.58.s:
sa yātu tasmātpāpācca taptasūrmīṃ ca pātakī ..
śaśvaddagdho bhavatu sa yāvadindrāścaturdaśa .. 89 ..
2.58.d:
स यातु तस्मात्पापाच्च तप्तसूर्मीं च पातकी ॥
शश्वद्दग्धो भवतु स यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ॥ 89 ॥
2.58.m:
May that sinner go from that sin to Taptasūrmī;
may he be constantly burned as long as the fourteen Indras endure. // 89

2.58.s:
tasmādutīryya cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāpnoti pātakī ..
saptajanmasu cāṇḍālo vṛṣabhaḥ pañcajanmasu .. 2.58.90 ..
2.58.d:
तस्मादुतीर्य्य चाण्डालीं योनिमाप्नोति पातकी ॥
सप्तजन्मसु चाण्डालो वृषभः पञ्चजन्मसु ॥ 2.58.90 ॥
2.58.m:
Emerging from that, the sinner obtains the womb of a Caṇḍālī;
he is a Caṇḍāla for seven births, and a bull for five births; // 90

2.58.s:
gardabho janmaśatakaṃ sūkarassaptajanmasu ..
tīrthadhvāṃkṣassaptasu vai viṭkṛmiḥ pañcajanmasu ..
jalaukā janmaśatakaṃ śucirbhavatu tatparam .. 91 ..
2.58.d:
गर्दभो जन्मशतकं सूकरस्सप्तजन्मसु ॥
तीर्थध्वांक्षस्सप्तसु वै विट्कृमिः पञ्चजन्मसु ॥
जलौका जन्मशतकं शुचिर्भवतु तत्परम् ॥ 91 ॥
2.58.m:
a donkey for a hundred births, a pig for seven births,
a pilgrimage-crow for seven births, and a dung-worm for five births, // 91
a leech for a hundred births—after that, may he become pure.

2.58.s:
vṛthā māṃsaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte svārthaṃ pākānnameva ca ..
tadadattaṃ mahāpāpī prāpnuyāccandrapātakam .. 92 ..
2.58.d:
वृथा मांसं च यो भुङ्क्ते स्वार्थं पाकान्नमेव च ॥
तददत्तं महापापी प्राप्नुयाच्चन्द्रपातकम् ॥ 92 ॥
2.58.m:
And he who eats meat not offered in sacrifice, cooked food only for his own sake,
that great sinner eats what has not been offered; he shall incur the sin of Candra. // 92

2.58.s:
sa yātu candrapāpena cāsipatraṃ caturyugam ..
tato bhavatu sarpaśca paśussyātsaptajanmasu .. 93 ..
2.58.d:
स यातु चन्द्रपापेन चासिपत्रं चतुर्युगम् ॥
ततो भवतु सर्पश्च पशुस्स्यात्सप्तजन्मसु ॥ 93 ॥
2.58.m:
By Candra's sin may he go to Asipatra for four yugas;
then may he become a snake, and an animal for seven births. // 93

2.58.s:
vipro vārdhuṣiko yo hi yonijīvī cikitsakaḥ ..
harernāmnāṃ ca vikretā yaśca vā svāṅgavikrayī ..94..
2.58.d:
विप्रो वार्धुषिको यो हि योनिजीवी चिकित्सकः ॥
हरेर्नाम्नां च विक्रेता यश्च वा स्वाङ्गविक्रयी ॥94॥
2.58.m:
A brahmin who is a usurer, one who lives off women's bodies, a physician,
one who sells the names of Hari, or one who sells his own limbs, // 94

2.58.s:
svadharmakathakaścaiva yaśca svātmapraśaṃsakaḥ ..
maṣījīvī dhāvakaśca kulaṭāpoṣya eva ca ..95..
2.58.d:
स्वधर्मकथकश्चैव यश्च स्वात्मप्रशंसकः ॥
मषीजीवी धावकश्च कुलटापोष्य एव च ॥95॥
2.58.m:
one who recites his own righteousness, one who praises himself,
one who lives by ink, a courier, and one maintained by an unchaste woman— // 95

2.58.s:
taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca candro bhavatu vijvaraḥ ..
sa yātu tena pāpena śūlaprotaṃ sudāruṇam ..96..
2.58.d:
तं यातु चन्द्रपापं च चन्द्रो भवतु विज्वरः ॥
स यातु तेन पापेन शूलप्रोतं सुदारुणम् ॥96॥
2.58.m:
may the sin of Candra go to him, and may Candra be free from affliction!
May he go, by that sin, to the terrible Śūlaprota! // 96

2.58.s:
tatra viddho bhavatu sa yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ..
tato daridro rogī ca dīkṣāhīno naraḥ paśuḥ .. 97 ..
2.58.d:
तत्र विद्धो भवतु स यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश ॥
ततो दरिद्रो रोगी च दीक्षाहीनो नरः पशुः ॥ 97 ॥
2.58.m:
There may he be pierced as long as the fourteen Indras endure.
Then, a poor man, diseased, uninitiated, a human beast; // 97

2.58.s:
lākṣāmāṃsarasānāṃ ca tilānāṃ lavaṇasya ca ..
aśvānāṃ caiva lauhānāṃ vikretā naraghātakaḥ .. 98 ..
2.58.d:
लाक्षामांसरसानां च तिलानां लवणस्य च ॥
अश्वानां चैव लौहानां विक्रेता नरघातकः ॥ 98 ॥
2.58.m:
and a seller of lac, meat, liquids, sesame seeds, and salt,
and of horses and irons, a murderer of humans, // 98

2.58.s:
vipraḥ kulālaḥ cauraśca yātu taṃ candrapātakam ..
sa yātu tena pāpena kṣuradhāraṃ suduḥsaham .. 99 ..
2.58.d:
विप्रः कुलालः चौरश्च यातु तं चन्द्रपातकम् ॥
स यातु तेन पापेन क्षुरधारं सुदुःसहम् ॥ 99 ॥
2.58.m:
a degraded brahmin, and a thief—may that sin of Candra go to him!
May he go, by that sin, to the unbearable Kṣuradhāra! // 99

2.58.s:
tatra cchinno bhavatu sa yāvadindrasahasrakam ..
tasmāduttīryya sa bhavetsṛgālaḥ saptajanmasu .. 2.58.100 ..
2.58.d:
तत्र च्छिन्नो भवतु स यावदिन्द्रसहस्रकम् ॥
तस्मादुत्तीर्य्य स भवेत्सृगालः सप्तजन्मसु ॥ 2.58.100 ॥
2.58.m:
There may he be cut into pieces as long as a thousand Indras endure.
Emerging from that, he shall become a jackal for seven births; // 100

2.58.s:
saptajanmasu mārjāro mahiṣo janmapañcakam ..
saptajanmasu bhallūkaḥ kukkurassaptajanmasu .. 101 ..
2.58.d:
सप्तजन्मसु मार्जारो महिषो जन्मपञ्चकम् ॥
सप्तजन्मसु भल्लूकः कुक्कुरस्सप्तजन्मसु ॥ 101 ॥
2.58.m:
for seven births a cat; a buffalo for five births;
for seven births a bear; a dog for seven births; // 101

2.58.s:
matsyatve janmaśatakaṃ karkaṭī janmapañcakam ..
godhikā janmaśatakaṃ gardabhaḥ saptajanmasu .. 102 ..
2.58.d:
मत्स्यत्वे जन्मशतकं कर्कटी जन्मपञ्चकम् ॥
गोधिका जन्मशतकं गर्दभः सप्तजन्मसु ॥ 102 ॥
2.58.m:
as a fish for a hundred births; a crab for five births;
a lizard for a hundred births; a donkey for seven births; // 102

2.58.s:
saptajanmasu maṇḍūkastataḥ syānmānavo'dhamaḥ ..
carmmakāraśca rajakastailakāraśca varddhakiḥ ..1 03..
2.58.d:
सप्तजन्मसु मण्डूकस्ततः स्यान्मानवोऽधमः ॥
चर्म्मकारश्च रजकस्तैलकारश्च वर्द्धकिः ॥1 03॥
2.58.m:
a frog for seven births; after that he may become a lowly human:
a leather-worker, a washerman, an oil-presser, and a carpenter, // 103

2.58.s:
nāvikaḥ śavajīvī ca vyādhaśca svarṇakārakaḥ ..
kumbhakāro lohakārastataḥ kṣatrastato dvijaḥ .. 104 ..
2.58.d:
नाविकः शवजीवी च व्याधश्च स्वर्णकारकः ॥
कुम्भकारो लोहकारस्ततः क्षत्रस्ततो द्विजः ॥ 104 ॥
2.58.m:
a boatman, one who lives off corpses, a hunter, a goldsmith,
a potter, an ironsmith, then a Kṣatriya, and then a brahmin. // 104

2.58.s:
iti candraṃ śuciṃ kṛtvā samuvāca tu tārakām ..
tyaktvā candraṃ mahāsādhvi gaccha kāntamiti dvijaḥ .. 109 ..
2.58.d:
इति चन्द्रं शुचिं कृत्वा समुवाच तु तारकाम् ॥
त्यक्त्वा चन्द्रं महासाध्वि गच्छ कान्तमिति द्विजः ॥ 109 ॥
2.58.m:
Having thus purified Candra, [the brahmin Śukra] spoke to Tārakā:
“O greatly chaste woman, having left Candra, go to your husband!” Thus spoke the brahmin: // 105

2.58.s:
prāyaścittaṃ vinā pūtā tvamevaṃ śuddhamānasā ..
akāmā yā baliṣṭhena na strī jāreṇa duṣyati .. 106 ..
2.58.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं विना पूता त्वमेवं शुद्धमानसा ॥
अकामा या बलिष्ठेन न स्त्री जारेण दुष्यति ॥ 106 ॥
2.58.m:
“Even without an expiation, you are thus purified, being pure of mind.
A woman who is unwilling is not defiled by a paramour who is stronger.” // 106

2.58.s:
ityevamuktvā śukraśca candraṃ vā tārakāṃ satīm ..
sasmitāṃ sasmitaṃ caiva cakāra ca śubhāśiṣaḥ .. 107 ..
2.58.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा शुक्रश्च चन्द्रं वा तारकां सतीम् ॥
सस्मितां सस्मितं चैव चकार च शुभाशिषः ॥ 107 ॥
2.58.m:
Having spoken thus, Śukra, smiling, conferred auspicious blessings
upon Candra and upon the smiling, chaste Tārakā. // 107

2.59.s:
nārada uvāca ..
bṛhaspatiḥ kiṃ cakāra tārakāharaṇāntare..
kathaṃ saṃprāpa tāṃ sādhvīṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi .. 1 ..
2.59.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
बृहस्पतिः किं चकार तारकाहरणान्तरे॥
कथं संप्राप तां साध्वीं तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥ 1 ॥

2.59.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
dṛṣṭvā vilambaṃ tārāyāḥ snāntyāścāpi guruḥ svayam ..
prasthāpayāmāsa śiṣyamanveṣārthaṃ ca jāhnavīm..2..
2.59.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
दृष्ट्वा विलम्बं तारायाः स्नान्त्याश्चापि गुरुः स्वयम् ॥
प्रस्थापयामास शिष्यमन्वेषार्थं च जाह्नवीम्॥2॥

2.59.s:
śiṣyo gatvā ca tadvattaṃ jñātvā vai lokavaktrataḥ..
rudannuvāca svaguruṃ tārakāharaṇaṃ mune..3..
2.59.d:
शिष्यो गत्वा च तद्वत्तं ज्ञात्वा वै लोकवक्त्रतः॥
रुदन्नुवाच स्वगुरुं तारकाहरणं मुने॥3॥

2.59.s:
śrutvā suragururvārtāṃ śaśinā ca priyāṃ hṛtām ..
muhūrttaṃ prāpa mūrcchāṃ ca tataḥ saṃprāpya cetanām .. 4 ..
2.59.d:
श्रुत्वा सुरगुरुर्वार्तां शशिना च प्रियां हृताम् ॥
मुहूर्त्तं प्राप मूर्च्छां च ततः संप्राप्य चेतनाम् ॥ 4 ॥

2.59.s:
rurodoccaiḥ saśiṣyaśca hadayena vidūyatā ..
śokena lajjayā''viṣṭo vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ..5..
2.59.d:
रुरोदोच्चैः सशिष्यश्च हदयेन विदूयता ॥
शोकेन लज्जया'ऽविष्टो विललाप मुहुर्मुहुः॥5॥

2.59.s:
uvāca śiṣyānsambodhya nītiṃ ca śrutisammatām ..
sāśrunetraḥ sāśrunetrāñchokārtaḥ śokakarśitān ..6..
2.59.d:
उवाच शिष्यान्सम्बोध्य नीतिं च श्रुतिसम्मताम् ॥
साश्रुनेत्रः साश्रुनेत्राञ्छोकार्तः शोककर्शितान् ॥6॥

2.59.s:
bṛhaspatiruvāca ..
he vatsāḥ kena śapto'haṃ na jāne kāraṇaṃ param ..
duḥkhaṃ dharmmaviruddho yaḥ sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ..7..
2.59.d:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच ॥
हे वत्साः केन शप्तोऽहं न जाने कारणं परम् ॥
दुःखं धर्म्मविरुद्धो यः स प्राप्नोति न संशयः ॥7॥

2.59.s:
yasya nāsti satī bhāryyā gṛheṣu priyavādinī ..
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham .. 6 ..
2.59.d:
यस्य नास्ति सती भार्य्या गृहेषु प्रियवादिनी ॥
अरण्यं तेन गन्तव्यं यथाऽरण्यं तथा गृहम् ॥ 6 ॥

2.59.s:
bhāvānuraktā vanitā hṛtā yasya ca śatruṇā ..
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham .. 9 ..
2.59.d:
भावानुरक्ता वनिता हृता यस्य च शत्रुणा ॥
अरण्यं तेन गन्तव्यं यथाऽरण्यं तथा गृहम् ॥ 9 ॥

2.59.s:
suśīlā sundarī bhāryyā gatā yasya gṛhādaho ..
araṇyaṃ tena ganta vyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham ..2.59.10..
2.59.d:
सुशीला सुन्दरी भार्य्या गता यस्य गृहादहो ॥
अरण्यं तेन गन्त व्यं यथाऽरण्यं तथा गृहम् ॥2.59.10॥

2.59.s:
daivenāpahṛtā yasya patisādhyā pativratā ..
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ yathā gṛham .. 11 ..
2.59.d:
दैवेनापहृता यस्य पतिसाध्या पतिव्रता ॥
अरण्यं तेन गन्तव्यं यथाऽरण्यं यथा गृहम् ॥ 11 ॥

2.59.s:
yasya mātā gṛhe nāsti gṛhiṇī vā suśāsitā ..
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham .. 12 ..
2.59.d:
यस्य माता गृहे नास्ति गृहिणी वा सुशासिता ॥
अरण्यं तेन गन्तव्यं यथाऽरण्यं तथा गृहम् ॥ 12 ॥

2.59.s:
priyāhīnaṃ gṛhaṃ yasya pūrṇaṃ draviṇabandhubhiḥ ..
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham .. 13 ..
2.59.d:
प्रियाहीनं गृहं यस्य पूर्णं द्रविणबन्धुभिः ॥
अरण्यं तेन गन्तव्यं यथाऽरण्यं तथा गृहम् ॥ 13 ॥

2.59.s:
bhāryāśūnyā vanasamāḥ sabhāryāśca gṛhā gṛhāḥ ..
gṛhiṇī ca gṛhaṃ proktaṃ na gṛhaṃ gṛhamucyate ..14..
2.59.d:
भार्याशून्या वनसमाः सभार्याश्च गृहा गृहाः ॥
गृहिणी च गृहं प्रोक्तं न गृहं गृहमुच्यते ॥14॥

2.59.s:
aśuciḥ strīvihīnaśca daive pitrye ca karmaṇi ..
yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet..15..
2.59.d:
अशुचिः स्त्रीविहीनश्च दैवे पित्र्ये च कर्मणि ॥
यदह्ना कुरुते कर्म न तस्य फलभाग्भवेत्॥15॥

2.59.s:
dāhikāśaktihīnaśca yathā mando hutāśanaḥ ..
prabhāhīno yathā sūryyaḥ śobhāhīno yathā śaśī .. 16 ..
2.59.d:
दाहिकाशक्तिहीनश्च यथा मन्दो हुताशनः ॥
प्रभाहीनो यथा सूर्य्यः शोभाहीनो यथा शशी ॥ 16 ॥

2.59.s:
śaktihīno yathā jīvo yathā cātmā tanuṃ vinā ..
vinā''dhāraṃ yathā''dheyo yatheśaḥ prakṛtiṃ vinā .. 17 ..
2.59.d:
शक्तिहीनो यथा जीवो यथा चात्मा तनुं विना ॥
विना'ऽधारं यथा'ऽधेयो यथेशः प्रकृतिं विना ॥ 17 ॥

2.59.s:
na ca śakto yathā yajñaḥ phalado dakṣiṇāṃ vinā..
karmaṇāṃ ca phalaṃ dātuṃ sāmagrī mūlameva ca .. 18 ..
2.59.d:
न च शक्तो यथा यज्ञः फलदो दक्षिणां विना॥
कर्मणां च फलं दातुं सामग्री मूलमेव च ॥ 18 ॥

2.59.s:
vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāro yathā śaktaḥ svakarmaṇi ..
yathā śaktaḥ kulālaśca mṛttikāṃ ca vinā dvijāḥ .. 19 ..
2.59.d:
विना स्वर्णं स्वर्णकारो यथा शक्तः स्वकर्मणि ॥
यथा शक्तः कुलालश्च मृत्तिकां च विना द्विजाः ॥ 19 ॥

2.59.s:
tathā gṛhī na śaktaśca satataṃ sarvakarmaṇi ..
gṛhādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca svaśaktigṛhiṇīṃ vinā .. 2.59.20 ..
2.59.d:
तथा गृही न शक्तश्च सततं सर्वकर्मणि ॥
गृहाधिष्ठातृदेवीं च स्वशक्तिगृहिणीं विना ॥ 2.59.20 ॥

2.59.s:
bhāryyāmūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā bhāryyāmūlā gṛhāstathā ..
bhāryyāmūlaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ gṛhe sadā .. 21 ..
2.59.d:
भार्य्यामूलाः क्रियाः सर्वा भार्य्यामूला गृहास्तथा ॥
भार्य्यामूलं सुखं सर्वं गृहस्थानां गृहे सदा ॥ 21 ॥

2.59.s:
bhāryyāmūlaḥ sadā harṣo bhāryyāmūlaṃ ca maṅgalam ..
bhāryyāmūlaṃ ca saṃsāro bhāryyāmūlaṃ ca saurabham .. 22 ..
2.59.d:
भार्य्यामूलः सदा हर्षो भार्य्यामूलं च मङ्गलम् ॥
भार्य्यामूलं च संसारो भार्य्यामूलं च सौरभम् ॥ 22 ॥

2.59.s:
yathā rathaśca rathināṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca tathā gṛham ..
sārathistu yathā teṣāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca tathā priyā .. 23 ..
2.59.d:
यथा रथश्च रथिनां गृहिणां च तथा गृहम् ॥
सारथिस्तु यथा तेषां गृहिणां च तथा प्रिया ॥ 23 ॥

2.59.s:
sarvaratnapradhānā ca strīratnaṃ duṣkulādapi ..
gṛhītā sā gṛhasthenevetyāha kamalodbhavaḥ .. 24 ..
2.59.d:
सर्वरत्नप्रधाना च स्त्रीरत्नं दुष्कुलादपि ॥
गृहीता सा गृहस्थेनेवेत्याह कमलोद्भवः ॥ 24 ॥

2.59.s:
yathā jalaṃ vinā padmaṃ padmaṃ śobhāṃ vinā yathā ..
tathaiva puṃsāṃ svagṛhaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ gṛhiṇīṃ vinā .. 25 ..
2.59.d:
यथा जलं विना पद्मं पद्मं शोभां विना यथा ॥
तथैव पुंसां स्वगृहं गृहिणां गृहिणीं विना ॥ 25 ॥

2.59.s:
ityevamuktvā sa guruḥ praviveśa gṛhaṃ muhuḥ ..
gṛhādbahirnissasāra bhūyo bhūyaḥ śucā'nvitaḥ .. 26 ..
2.59.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स गुरुः प्रविवेश गृहं मुहुः ॥
गृहाद्बहिर्निस्ससार भूयो भूयः शुचाऽन्वितः ॥ 26 ॥

2.59.s:
muhurmuhuśca mūrcchāṃ ca cetanāṃ samavāpa saḥ ..
bhūyobhūyo rurodoccaiḥ smāraṃsmāraṃ priyāguṇān .. 27 ..
2.59.d:
मुहुर्मुहुश्च मूर्च्छां च चेतनां समवाप सः ॥
भूयोभूयो रुरोदोच्चैः स्मारंस्मारं प्रियागुणान् ॥ 27 ॥

2.59.s:
athāntare mahājñānī jñānibhiśca prabodhitaḥ ..
sacchiṣyairmunibhiścānyaiḥ purandaragṛhaṃ yayau .. 28 ..
2.59.d:
अथान्तरे महाज्ञानी ज्ञानिभिश्च प्रबोधितः ॥
सच्छिष्यैर्मुनिभिश्चान्यैः पुरन्दरगृहं ययौ ॥ 28 ॥

2.59.s:
sa guruḥ pūjitastena cātithyena marutvatā ..
tamuvāca svavṛttāntaṃ hṛdi śalyamivāpriyam .. 29 ..
2.59.d:
स गुरुः पूजितस्तेन चातिथ्येन मरुत्वता ॥
तमुवाच स्ववृत्तान्तं हृदि शल्यमिवाप्रियम् ॥ 29 ॥

2.59.s:
bṛhaspativacaḥ śrutvā raktapaṅkajalocanaḥ ..
tamuvāca mahendraśca kopaprasphuritādharaḥ .. 2.59.30 ..
2.59.d:
बृहस्पतिवचः श्रुत्वा रक्तपङ्कजलोचनः ॥
तमुवाच महेन्द्रश्च कोपप्रस्फुरिताधरः ॥ 2.59.30 ॥

2.59.s:
mahendra uvāca ..
dūtānāṃ vai sahasraṃ ca cārakarmaṇi gacchatu ..
atīva nipuṇaṃ dakṣaṃ tattvaprāptinimittakam .. 31 ..
2.59.d:
महेन्द्र उवाच ॥
दूतानां वै सहस्रं च चारकर्मणि गच्छतु ॥
अतीव निपुणं दक्षं तत्त्वप्राप्तिनिमित्तकम् ॥ 31 ॥

2.59.s:
yatrāsti pātakī candro manmātrā tārayā saha ..
gacchāmi tatra sannaddhaḥ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha .. 32 ..
2.59.d:
यत्रास्ति पातकी चन्द्रो मन्मात्रा तारया सह ॥
गच्छामि तत्र सन्नद्धः सर्वैर्देवगणैः सह ॥ 32 ॥

2.59.s:
tyaja cintāṃ mahābhāga sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ..
bhadrabījaṃ durgamidaṃ kasya sampadvipadvinā .. 33 ..
2.59.d:
त्यज चिन्तां महाभाग सर्वं भद्रं भविष्यति ॥
भद्रबीजं दुर्गमिदं कस्य सम्पद्विपद्विना ॥ 33 ॥

2.59.s:
ityuktvā ca śunāsīro dūtānāṃ ca sahasrakam ..
tūrṇaṃ prasthāpa yāmāsa tatkarmanipuṇaṃ mune .. 34 ..
2.59.d:
इत्युक्त्वा च शुनासीरो दूतानां च सहस्रकम् ॥
तूर्णं प्रस्थाप यामास तत्कर्मनिपुणं मुने ॥ 34 ॥

2.59.s:
te dūtā vai varṣaśataṃ yayurnirjanameva ca ..
sudurlaṃghyaṃ ca viśveṣu bhramitvā śakramāyayuḥ .. 35 ..
2.59.d:
ते दूता वै वर्षशतं ययुर्निर्जनमेव च ॥
सुदुर्लंघ्यं च विश्वेषु भ्रमित्वा शक्रमाययुः ॥ 35 ॥

2.59.s:
candraṃ ca śukrabhavane taṃ prapannaṃ ca vijvaram ..
dṛṣṭvā satārakaṃ bhītaṃ kathayāmāsurīśvaram .. 36 ..
2.59.d:
चन्द्रं च शुक्रभवने तं प्रपन्नं च विज्वरम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा सतारकं भीतं कथयामासुरीश्वरम् ॥ 36 ॥

2.59.s:
iti śrutvā śunāsīro natavaktro bṛhaspatim ..
uvāca śokasantapto hadayena vidūyatā .. 37 ..
2.59.d:
इति श्रुत्वा शुनासीरो नतवक्त्रो बृहस्पतिम् ॥
उवाच शोकसन्तप्तो हदयेन विदूयता ॥ 37 ॥

2.59.s:
mahendra uvāca ..
śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi pariṇāmasukhāvaham ..
bhayaṃ tyaja mahābhāga sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati .. 38 ..
2.59.d:
महेन्द्र उवाच ॥
शृणु नाथ प्रवक्ष्यामि परिणामसुखावहम् ॥
भयं त्यज महाभाग सर्वं भद्रं भविष्यति ॥ 38 ॥

2.59.s:
tvayā nahi jitaḥ śukro na mayā ditinandanaḥ ..
etadālocya candraśca jagāma śaraṇaṃ kavim ..39..
2.59.d:
त्वया नहि जितः शुक्रो न मया दितिनन्दनः ॥
एतदालोच्य चन्द्रश्च जगाम शरणं कविम् ॥39॥

2.59.s:
gaccha śīghraṃ brahmalokamasmābhiḥ sārddhameva ca ..
brahmaṇā saha yāsyāmaḥ kailāse śaṅkaraṃ vayam ..2.59.40 ..
2.59.d:
गच्छ शीघ्रं ब्रह्मलोकमस्माभिः सार्द्धमेव च ॥
ब्रह्मणा सह यास्यामः कैलासे शङ्करं वयम् ॥2.59.40 ॥

2.59.s:
ityuktvā tu mahendraśca santapto guruṇā saha ..
jagāma brahmalokaṃ ca sukhadṛśyaṃ nirāmayam .. 41 ..
2.59.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तु महेन्द्रश्च सन्तप्तो गुरुणा सह ॥
जगाम ब्रह्मलोकं च सुखदृश्यं निरामयम् ॥ 41 ॥
2.59.m:
Having spoken thus, Mahendra, distressed, went with the guru
to Brahmaloka, pleasant to behold and free from disease.

2.59.s:
tatra dṛṣṭvā ca brahmāṇaṃ nanāma guruṇā saha ..
provāca sarvavṛttāntaṃ devānāmīśvaraṃ param .. 42 ..
2.59.d:
तत्र दृष्ट्वा च ब्रह्माणं ननाम गुरुणा सह ॥
प्रोवाच सर्ववृत्तान्तं देवानामीश्वरं परम् ॥ 42 ॥
2.59.m:
Seeing Brahmā there, he bowed together with the guru;
he related the entire matter to the supreme lord of the gods.

2.59.s:
mahendravacanaṃ śrutvā hasitvā kamalodbhavaḥ ..
hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāramuvāca vinayānvitaḥ .. 43 ..
2.59.d:
महेन्द्रवचनं श्रुत्वा हसित्वा कमलोद्भवः ॥
हितं तथ्यं नीतिसारमुवाच विनयान्वितः ॥ 43 ॥
2.59.m:
Hearing Mahendra's words, the lotus-born [Brahmā] laughed,
and, endowed with modesty, spoke beneficial, true, and essential counsel:

2.59.s:
brahmovāca ..
yo dadāti parasmai ca duḥkhameva ca sarvataḥ ..
tasmai dadāti duḥkhaṃ ca śāstā kṛṣṇaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 44 ..
2.59.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
यो ददाति परस्मै च दुःखमेव च सर्वतः ॥
तस्मै ददाति दुःखं च शास्ता कृष्णः सनातनः ॥ 44 ॥
2.59.m:
"He who gives suffering alone to another on all sides—
to him the punisher, eternal Kṛṣṇa, gives suffering in turn.

2.59.s:
ahaṃ sraṣṭā ca sṛṣṭeśca pātā viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ..
yathā rudraśca saṃharttā dadāti ca śivaṃ śivaḥ .. 45 ..
2.59.d:
अहं स्रष्टा च सृष्टेश्च पाता विष्णुः सनातनः ॥
यथा रुद्रश्च संहर्त्ता ददाति च शिवं शिवः ॥ 45 ॥
2.59.m:
I am the creator of creation, and eternal Viṣṇu is its protector;
just as Rudra is the destroyer, Śiva bestows what is auspicious.

2.59.s:
nirantaraṃ sarvasākṣī dharmo vai sarvakāraṇam ..
sarve devā viṣayiṇaḥ kṛṣṇājñāparipālakāḥ .. 46 ..
2.59.d:
निरन्तरं सर्वसाक्षी धर्मो वै सर्वकारणम् ॥
सर्वे देवा विषयिणः कृष्णाज्ञापरिपालकाः ॥ 46 ॥
2.59.m:
Dharma is ever the witness of all, indeed the cause of everything.
All gods are involved in worldly affairs, abiding by Kṛṣṇa's command.

2.59.s:
bṛhaspatirutathyaśca saṃvartaśca jitendriyaḥ ..
trayaścāṃgirasaḥ putrā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ .. 47 ..
2.59.d:
बृहस्पतिरुतथ्यश्च संवर्तश्च जितेन्द्रियः ॥
त्रयश्चांगिरसः पुत्रा वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः ॥ 47 ॥
2.59.m:
Bṛhaspati, Utathya, and Saṃvarta, whose senses are conquered,
are the three sons of Aṅgiras, masters of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

2.59.s:
saṃvartāya kaniṣṭhāya na ca kiñciddadau guruḥ ..
sa babhūva tapasvī ca kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyati ceśvaram .. 48 ..
2.59.d:
संवर्ताय कनिष्ठाय न च किञ्चिद्ददौ गुरुः ॥
स बभूव तपस्वी च कृष्णं ध्यायति चेश्वरम् ॥ 48 ॥
2.59.m:
The guru gave nothing to Saṃvarta, the youngest;
he became an ascetic and meditates upon the Lord, Kṛṣṇa.

2.59.s:
madhyamasyotathyakasya satīṃ bhāryāṃ ca gurviṇīm ..
jahāra kāmatastāṃ ca bhrātṛjāyāmakāmukīm .. 49 ..
2.59.d:
मध्यमस्योतथ्यकस्य सतीं भार्यां च गुर्विणीम् ॥
जहार कामतस्तां च भ्रातृजायामकामुकीम् ॥ 49 ॥
2.59.m:
The virtuous, pregnant wife of the middle one, Utathya—
out of lust he seized her, his brother's wife, though she did not desire it.

2.59.s:
yo haredbhrātṛjāyāṃ ca kāmī kāmādakāmukīm ..
brahmahatyāsahasraṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2.59.50 ..
2.59.d:
यो हरेद्भ्रातृजायां च कामी कामादकामुकीम् ॥
ब्रह्महत्यासहस्रं च लभते नात्र संशयः ॥ 2.59.50 ॥
2.59.m:
A lustful man who, out of desire, seizes his brother's wife when she does not desire it,
incurs [the sin of] a thousand slayings of brahmins; there is no doubt in this.

2.59.s:
sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvaccandradivākaram ..
bhrātṛjāyāpahārī ca mātṛgāmī bhavennaraḥ .. 51 ..
2.59.d:
स याति कुम्भीपाकं च यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरम् ॥
भ्रातृजायापहारी च मातृगामी भवेन्नरः ॥ 51 ॥
2.59.m: A man who abducts his brother's wife becomes one who violates his mother.

2.59.s:
tasmāduttīryya pāpī ca viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ ..
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi tatra sthitvā ca pātakī .. 52 ..
2.59.d:
तस्मादुत्तीर्य्य पापी च विष्ठायां जायते कृमिः ॥
वर्षकोटिसहस्राणि तत्र स्थित्वा च पातकी ॥ 52 ॥
2.59.m:
Having emerged from there, that sinner is born as a worm in excrement;
remaining there for thousands of crores of years, that sinner,

2.59.s:
tato bhavenmahāpāpī varṣakoṭisahasrakam ..
puṃścalīyonigarte ca kṛmiścaiva purandara .. .. 53 ..
2.59.d:
ततो भवेन्महापापी वर्षकोटिसहस्रकम् ॥
पुंश्चलीयोनिगर्ते च कृमिश्चैव पुरन्दर ॥ ॥ 53 ॥
2.59.m:
thereafter that great sinner, for thousands of crores of years,
[becomes] a worm in the pit of a prostitute's womb, O Purandara.

2.59.s:
gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni kukkuraḥ ..
bhrātṛjāyāpaharaṇācchatajanmāni sūkaraḥ .. 54 ..
2.59.d:
गृध्रः कोटिसहस्राणि शतजन्मानि कुक्कुरः ॥
भ्रातृजायापहरणाच्छतजन्मानि सूकरः ॥ 54 ॥
2.59.m:
For thousands of crores [of years] a vulture, for a hundred births a dog,
from abducting a brother's wife he becomes a boar for a hundred births.

2.59.s:
dadāti yo na dāyaṃ ca baliṣṭho durbalāya ca ..
sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvaccandradivākaram .. 95 ..
2.59.d:
ददाति यो न दायं च बलिष्ठो दुर्बलाय च ॥
स याति कुम्भीपाकं च यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरम् ॥ 95 ॥
2.59.m: The strong one who does not give an inheritance to the weak,

2.59.s:
nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karmma kalpakoṭiśatairapi ..
avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham .. 56 ..
2.59.d:
नाभुक्तं क्षीयते कर्म्म कल्पकोटिशतैरपि ॥
अवश्यमेव भोक्तव्यं कृतं कर्म शुभाशुभम् ॥ 56 ॥

2.59.s:
jagadguroḥ śivasyāpi guruputro bṛhaspatiḥ ..
jñātaṃ karotu vṛttāntamīśvaraṃ balināṃ varama .. 57 ..
2.59.d:
जगद्गुरोः शिवस्यापि गुरुपुत्रो बृहस्पतिः ॥
ज्ञातं करोतु वृत्तान्तमीश्वरं बलिनां वरम ॥ 57 ॥
2.59.m:
Bṛhaspati is the guru's son even of Śiva, the guru of the universe;
let him make the matter known to the Lord, the foremost of the mighty.

2.59.s:
sarve samūhā devānāṃ sannaddhāśca savāhanāḥ ..
madhyasthā munayaścaiva santu vai narmadātaṭe .. 58 ..
2.59.d:
सर्वे समूहा देवानां सन्नद्धाश्च सवाहनाः ॥
मध्यस्था मुनयश्चैव सन्तु वै नर्मदातटे ॥ 58 ॥
2.59.m:
Let all the hosts of gods, equipped with weapons and on their mounts,
and the neutral sages, be assembled on the bank of the Narmadā.

2.59.s:
paścādahaṃ ca yāsyāmi puṇyaṃ tannarmmadātaṭam ..
gurustadguruputro'pi śīghraṃ yātu śivālayam ..59..
2.59.d:
पश्चादहं च यास्यामि पुण्यं तन्नर्म्मदातटम् ॥
गुरुस्तद्गुरुपुत्रोऽपि शीघ्रं यातु शिवालयम् ॥59॥
2.59.m:
Afterwards I too shall go to that holy bank of the Narmadā.
Let the guru, that guru's son, go quickly to Śiva's abode."

2.59.s:
mahendra uvāca ..
kathaṃ vā vedakarttuśca siddhānāṃ yogināṃ guroḥ ..
mṛtyuñjayasya śambhośca guruputro bṛhaspatiḥ .. 2.59.60 ..
2.59.d:
महेन्द्र उवाच ॥
कथं वा वेदकर्त्तुश्च सिद्धानां योगिनां गुरोः ॥
मृत्युञ्जयस्य शम्भोश्च गुरुपुत्रो बृहस्पतिः ॥ 2.59.60 ॥
2.59.m:
"How is Bṛhaspati the son of the guru of the maker of the Vedas,
the guru of accomplished adepts and yogins, Mṛtyuñjaya Śambhu?

2.59.s:
aṅgirāstava putraśca tatputraśca bṛhaspatiḥ ..
tvatto jñānī mahādevaḥ kathaṃ śiṣyo guroḥ pituḥ .. 61 ..
2.59.d:
अङ्गिरास्तव पुत्रश्च तत्पुत्रश्च बृहस्पतिः ॥
त्वत्तो ज्ञानी महादेवः कथं शिष्यो गुरोः पितुः ॥ 61 ॥
2.59.m:
Aṅgiras is your son, and his son is Bṛhaspati;
Mahādeva is wiser than you—how is he the disciple of the guru's father?"

2.59.s:
brahmovāca ..
katheyamatiguptā ca purāṇeṣu purandara ..
imāṃ purāpravṛttiṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya..62..
2.59.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
कथेयमतिगुप्ता च पुराणेषु पुरन्दर ॥
इमां पुराप्रवृत्तिं च कथयामि निशामय॥62॥
2.59.m:
"This story is extremely secret in the Purāṇas, O Purandara.
I shall relate this ancient occurrence; listen.

2.59.s:
mṛtavatsā karmmadoṣādbhāryyā cāṅgirasaḥ purā ..
vrataṃ cakāra sā caiva kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ .. 63 ..
2.59.d:
मृतवत्सा कर्म्मदोषाद्भार्य्या चाङ्गिरसः पुरा ॥
व्रतं चकार सा चैव कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ॥ 63 ॥
2.59.m:
Formerly, through the fault of karma, the wife of Aṅgiras had stillborn children;
she performed a vow dedicated to Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman.

2.59.s:
vrataṃ puṃsavanaṃ nāma varṣamekaṃ cakāra sā ..
sanatkumāro bhagavānkārayāmāsa tāṃ vratam .. 64 ..
2.59.d:
व्रतं पुंसवनं नाम वर्षमेकं चकार सा ॥
सनत्कुमारो भगवान्कारयामास तां व्रतम् ॥ 64 ॥
2.59.m:
She performed the vow named puṃsavana for one year;
the blessed Sanatkumāra made her observe that vow.

2.59.s:
tadā''gatya ca golokātparamātmā kṛpāmayaḥ ..
svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ .. 65 ..
2.59.d:
तदा'ऽगत्य च गोलोकात्परमात्मा कृपामयः ॥
स्वेच्छामयं परं ब्रह्म भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहः ॥ 65 ॥
2.59.m:
Then, coming from Goloka, the compassionate Paramātman,
the supreme Brahman consisting of his own will, embodied to show grace to devotees,

2.59.s:
suvratāṃ ca salakṣmīkāṃ tāmuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ..
praṇatāṃ sāśrunetrāṃ ca vinītāṃ ca tayā stutaḥ .. 66 ..
2.59.d:
सुव्रतां च सलक्ष्मीकां तामुवाच कृपानिधिः ॥
प्रणतां साश्रुनेत्रां च विनीतां च तया स्तुतः ॥ 66 ॥
2.59.m:
the ocean of mercy spoke to her, the faithful observer of vows endowed with fortune,
who was bowed down, tearful-eyed, humble, and by whom he was praised.

2.59.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
gṛhāṇedaṃ vrataphalaṃ mama tejassamanvitam ..
bhuṃkṣva madvarataḥ putri bhaviṣyati madaṃśataḥ .. 67 ..
2.59.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
गृहाणेदं व्रतफलं मम तेजस्समन्वितम् ॥
भुंक्ष्व मद्वरतः पुत्रि भविष्यति मदंशतः ॥ 67 ॥
2.59.m:
"Accept this fruit of the vow, endowed with my splendor.
Consume it by my boon, daughter; from my portion there shall be born

2.59.s:
patirguruśca devānāṃ mahatāṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ ..
putraste bhavitā sādhvi madvareṇa bṛhaspatiḥ .. 68 ..
2.59.d:
पतिर्गुरुश्च देवानां महतां ज्ञानिनां वरः ॥
पुत्रस्ते भविता साध्वि मद्वरेण बृहस्पतिः ॥ 68 ॥
2.59.m:
the master and guru of the gods, the best of great wise men.
By my boon your son shall be Bṛhaspati, O virtuous woman.

2.59.s:
madvareṇa bhavedyo hi sa ca madvaraputrakaḥ ..
tvadgarbhe mama putro'yaṃ cirajīvī bhaviṣyati .. 69 ..
2.59.d:
मद्वरेण भवेद्यो हि स च मद्वरपुत्रकः ॥
त्वद्गर्भे मम पुत्रोऽयं चिरजीवी भविष्यति ॥ 69 ॥
2.59.m:
He who is born by my boon is indeed a son born of my boon.
In your womb this son of mine shall be long-lived.

2.59.s:
varajo vīryyajaścaiva kṣetrajaḥ pālakastathā..
vidyāmantrasutau caiva gṛhītaḥ saptamaḥ sutaḥ .. 2.59.70 ..
2.59.d:
वरजो वीर्य्यजश्चैव क्षेत्रजः पालकस्तथा॥
विद्यामन्त्रसुतौ चैव गृहीतः सप्तमः सुतः ॥ 2.59.70 ॥
2.59.m:
The son born of a boon, the son born of semen, the son born of the wife's womb, likewise the foster son,
and the two sons of knowledge and mantra, and an adopted son is the seventh.

2.59.s:
ityuktvā rādhikānāthaḥ svalokaṃ ca jagāma saḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇavaraputro'yaṃ jñānīśvaraguruḥ svayam ..
mṛtyuñjayaṃ mahājñānaṃ śivāya pradadau purā .. 71 ..
2.59.d:
इत्युक्त्वा राधिकानाथः स्वलोकं च जगाम सः ॥
श्रीकृष्णवरपुत्रोऽयं ज्ञानीश्वरगुरुः स्वयम् ॥
मृत्युञ्जयं महाज्ञानं शिवाय प्रददौ पुरा ॥ 71 ॥
2.59.m:
Having spoken thus, the lord of Rādhikā went to his own world.
This son born of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's boon, himself the teacher of the lord of the wise,
formerly imparted the great knowledge that conquers death to Śiva.

2.59.s:
divyaṃ varṣatrilakṣaṃ ca tapaścakre himālaye ..
svayogaṃ jñānamakhilaṃ tejassvāmasamaṃ param ..
svaśaktiṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ ca svāṃśaṃ vai vāhanaṃ vṛṣam .. 72..
2.59.d:
दिव्यं वर्षत्रिलक्षं च तपश्चक्रे हिमालये ॥
स्वयोगं ज्ञानमखिलं तेजस्स्वामसमं परम् ॥
स्वशक्तिं विष्णुमायां च स्वांशं वै वाहनं वृषम् ॥ 72॥
2.59.m:
For three hundred thousand divine years [Śiva] performed austerities on the Himālayas.
His own yoga, all knowledge, supreme splendor equal to his own,
his own śakti, the māyā of Viṣṇu, his own portion indeed—his vehicle the bull,

2.59.s:
svaśūlaṃ ca svakavacaṃ svamantraṃ dvādaśākṣaram ..
kṛpāmayaḥ stutastena śrīkṛṣṇaśca parātparaḥ ..
śivaloke śivā sā ca viṣṇumāyā śivapriyā ..73..
2.59.d:
स्वशूलं च स्वकवचं स्वमन्त्रं द्वादशाक्षरम् ॥
कृपामयः स्तुतस्तेन श्रीकृष्णश्च परात्परः ॥
शिवलोके शिवा सा च विष्णुमाया शिवप्रिया ॥73॥
2.59.m:
his trident, his armour, his twelve-syllabled mantra—
the compassionate and higher-than-the-highest Śrī Kṛṣṇa was praised by him.
In Śivaloka she is Śivā, the māyā of Viṣṇu, beloved of Śiva.

2.59.s:
śaktirnārāyaṇasyeyaṃ sā''virbhūtā sanātanī ..
tejastu sarvadevānāṃ sā''virbhūtā sanātanī .. 74 ..
2.59.d:
शक्तिर्नारायणस्येयं सा'ऽविर्भूता सनातनी ॥
तेजस्तु सर्वदेवानां सा'ऽविर्भूता सनातनी ॥ 74 ॥
2.59.m:
She, the eternal śakti of Nārāyaṇa, manifested herself;
as the splendor of all the gods, that eternal one manifested herself.

2.59.s:
jaghāna daityanikaraṃ devebhyaḥ pradadau padam ..
kalpānte dakṣakanyā ca sā mūlaprakṛtiḥ satī .. 75 ..
2.59.d:
जघान दैत्यनिकरं देवेभ्यः प्रददौ पदम् ॥
कल्पान्ते दक्षकन्या च सा मूलप्रकृतिः सती ॥ 75 ॥
2.59.m:
She slew the multitude of Daityas and granted sovereignty to the gods.
At the end of the kalpa, that primal Prakṛti became Satī, daughter of Dakṣa.

2.59.s:
pitṛyajñe tanuṃ tyaktvā yogādvai siddhayoginī ..
babhūva śailakanyā sā sādhvī vai bhartṛnindayā ..76..
2.59.d:
पितृयज्ञे तनुं त्यक्त्वा योगाद्वै सिद्धयोगिनी ॥
बभूव शैलकन्या सा साध्वी वै भर्तृनिन्दया ॥76॥
2.59.m:
Having abandoned her body at her father's sacrifice through yoga, indeed an accomplished yoginī,
that chaste woman became the daughter of the Mountain on account of the reviling of her husband.

2.59.s:
kālena kṛṣṇatapasā śaṅkaraṃ prāpa sundarī..
śrīkṛṣṇo hi guruḥ śambhoḥ paramātmā parātparaḥ.77..
2.59.d:
कालेन कृष्णतपसा शङ्करं प्राप सुन्दरी॥
श्रीकृष्णो हि गुरुः शम्भोः परमात्मा परात्परः.77॥
2.59.m:
In time, through austerities to Kṛṣṇa, the beautiful woman obtained Śaṅkara.
